The same sourcing and accuracy requirements apply to every candidate; the initial selection is neither a ranking nor an endorsement.

title.ht: Martelly ak frè 1.50 dola a: ki sa fanmi yo t ap finanse?
title.en: Martelly and the $1.50 fee: what were families paying for?

description.ht: Anba prezidans Martelly, yon frè sou transfè vin pote yon pwomès lekòl gratis. Yon pwosè vin konteste fason sistèm nan te mache.
description.en: Under Martelly, a transfer fee became part of a promise of free schooling. A lawsuit later challenged how the arrangement worked.

text.ht: Chak fwa yon fanmi peye frè 1.50 dola a sou yon transfè, gen mwens lajan ki rete pou lòt bezwen. Dis fwa 1.50 dola, se 15 dola: frè sèvis konpayi an poko ladan l.
text.en: Every time a family pays the $1.50 transfer fee, less money remains for other needs. Ten payments of this fee cost $15, before the company’s other service charges.

text.ht: Sistèm sa a te kòmanse anba prezidans Michel Martelly. Rapò anyèl Bank Repiblik Ayiti konfime Sikilè 98 te fikse yon frè 1.50 dola ameriken sou transfè k ap antre oswa soti nan peyi a, avèk dat aplikasyon 1ye Jen 2011.
text.en: The arrangement began under President Michel Martelly. Haiti’s central bank’s annual report confirms that Circular 98 established a US$1.50 fee on incoming and outgoing transfers, effective June 1, 2011.

text.ht: Pwomès la se te ede timoun ale lekòl gratis. Yon desizyon tribinal ameriken an 2023 dekri videyo kote Martelly ak Denis O’Brien, prezidan konsèy Digicel nan epòk la, esplike pwojè finansman edikasyon an. Se konsa yon ti frè sou transfè te vin antre nan yon gwo pwomès politik.
text.en: The promise was to help children attend school free of charge. A 2023 U.S. court decision describes videos in which Martelly and then-Digicel chairman Denis O’Brien explained the education-funding plan. A small transfer fee had become part of a large political promise.

text.ht: Konbyen lajan sa te bay? Nan rapò 2017–2018 li a, Koudèkont la, ki egzamine kont Leta yo, bay yon premye repons. Li rapòte BRH te ranmase anviwon 120 milyon dola ameriken sou transfè ant 2011 ak 2018 pou Fon Nasyonal Edikasyon an, FNE. Prèske 118 milyon dola te ale nan Trezò piblik la, kote Leta jere lajan li. Tablo a bay yon rès anviwon 2.37 milyon dola nan fen peryòd la.
text.en: How much money did that produce? Haiti’s audit court supplies a first answer in its report for 2017–2018. It reports about US$120 million collected through the central bank from transfer fees in 2011–2018 for the National Education Fund, or FNE. Nearly $118 million went to the Treasury, which manages government money. The table records about $2.37 million remaining at the period’s end.

text.ht: Kidonk, gen tras ofisyèl ki montre lajan te antre nan kont Leta. Rapò a dekri travay konstriksyon ak reparasyon lekòl tou. Men li di Koudèkont la rezève dwa pou l al verifye kantite ak kalite sal klas yo sou teren.
text.en: There is therefore an official trail into government accounts. The report also describes school construction and rehabilitation. But the court reserves the right to check classroom numbers and construction quality through site visits.

text.ht: Sa poko reponn kesyon chak fanmi an: ki rezilta frè mwen yo te bay? Yon transfè bay Trezò pa otomatikman yon timoun ki jwenn plas lekòl. Pou mezire pwomès Martelly a, pwochen etap la se konekte lajan Leta resevwa ak depans, lekòl ak elèv ki benefisye. Se la rann kont lan dwe rive.
text.en: That still leaves each family’s question: what did my fees achieve? A Treasury transfer does not automatically become a school place. Assessing Martelly’s promise requires connecting government receipts to spending, schools and the children who benefited. Accountability has to reach that last step.

title.ht: Martelly ak Privert: ki sa plent sou lajan lekòl la te di?
title.en: Martelly and Privert: what did the school-fee lawsuit allege?

description.ht: Yon gwoup moun t al lajistis Ozetazini pou frè transfè ak apèl yo. Men akizasyon yo, repons tribinal la ak sa ki poko pwouve.
description.en: A group of U.S. residents challenged the transfer and call charges. Here are their allegations, the court’s response and the limits of the evidence.

text.ht: An 2018, yon gwoup moun ki t ap viv Ozetazini te pote plent nan New York. Yo te di lajan yo t ap peye sou transfè ak apèl pou Ayiti pa t sèvi jan yo te pwomèt la. Yo te akize Martelly ak konpayi transfè lajan ak telefòn dèske yo te antann yo pou enpoze frè ilegal. Yo te akize prezidan ki vin apre l yo, Jocelerme Privert ak Jovenel Moïse, dèske yo te kontinye sistèm nan epi pwofite ladan l.
text.en: In 2018, a group of U.S. residents sued in New York. They said money charged on transfers and calls to Haiti had not served its promised purpose. They accused Martelly and money-transfer and telephone companies of agreeing to impose unlawful fees. They accused his successors, Jocelerme Privert and Jovenel Moïse, of continuing and benefiting from the arrangement.

text.ht: Akizasyon santral la te grav: konpayi ak prezidan yo ta kenbe yon pati nan lajan ki te prezante kòm finansman lekòl. Sa se sa pleyan yo te deklare; se pa yon konklizyon ki pwouve yo te vòlè lajan.
text.en: Their central accusation was serious: companies and presidents had allegedly kept some of the money presented as school funding. That was the plaintiffs’ claim, not an established finding of theft.

text.ht: Pou konprann plent lan, fòk nou separe de frè yo. Sikilè BRH yo te konsène transfè lajan. Yon desizyon prezidansyèl te konsène apèl entènasyonal: dapre sa tribinal la rapòte, senk santim sou yon pri minimòm 23 santim pa minit te dwe ale bay CONATEL, òganis ki kontwole telekominikasyon yo. Objektif ki te ekri pou frè apèl sa a se te konbat fwod telefòn. Pleyan yo te konteste diferans ant tèks sa yo ak pwomès lekòl gratis la.
text.en: Understanding the complaint requires separating two charges. Central-bank circulars concerned money transfers. A presidential order concerned international calls: as recounted by the court, five cents of a minimum 23-cent-per-minute price was to go to CONATEL, Haiti’s telecommunications regulator. The stated purpose of that call fee was fighting telephone fraud. The plaintiffs challenged the gap between those texts and the school promise.

text.ht: Men ki repons tribinal yo te bay? An 2022, tribinal apèl la te relouvri chemen pou dosye a kontinye. Sa pa t pwouve akizasyon yo. An 2023, jij la te rejte plizyè reklamasyon, ladan yo sa ki te baze sou fwod, epi li te kite reklamasyon anba lwa ameriken sou kominikasyon an kontinye.
text.en: What did the courts decide? In 2022, an appeals court reopened the path for the case to proceed. That did not prove the allegations. In 2023, the judge dismissed several claims, including fraud claims, while allowing Communications Act claims to proceed.

text.ht: An 2025, tribinal la te mete yon penalite 5,000 dola sou de avoka pleyan yo pou reklamasyon kont Unibank ak Unitransfer. Se pa ansyen prezidan yo penalite sa a te frape.
text.en: In 2025, the court imposed a $5,000 penalty on two plaintiffs’ lawyers concerning claims against Unibank and Unitransfer. That penalty was not imposed on the former presidents.

text.ht: Dosye sa a se sivil; desizyon sa yo pa yon kondanasyon kriminèl. Yon akizasyon ka soulve yon kesyon enpòtan san li pa deja bay repons lan. Pou kesyon lajan lekòl la, prèv sou kont ak depans yo toujou esansyèl.
text.en: This is a civil case; these decisions are not criminal convictions. An accusation can raise an important question without answering it. For the school-money question, evidence of receipts and spending remains essential.

title.ht: Lajan lekòl la: yon pwoblèm nan kont Leta yo te kontinye
title.en: School-fee money: the accounting problem continued

description.ht: Yon rapò ki kouvri 2023–2024 montre revni FNE yo te antre nan kalkil diferans ant revni ak depans Leta yo, men depans FNE yo pa t ladan l. Poukisa sa enpòtan?
description.en: A report covering 2023–2024 says FNE revenue was counted in the government budget balance while its spending was left out. Why does that matter?

text.ht: Yon fanmi bezwen konnen sa li resevwa ak sa li depanse pou l konnen konbyen lajan ki rete. Si li konte yon revni, men li bliye depans ki mache avè l, rès la ap parèt pi gwo pase sa li ye.
text.en: A family needs to count both income and spending to know what remains. Count the income but leave out the related spending, and the balance looks larger than it is.

text.ht: Koudèkont la idantifye yon pwoblèm konsa nan kont Leta pou ane bidjè 2023–2024. Rapò li a di Ministè Ekonomi ak Finans te mete resous ki fèt pou finanse Fon Nasyonal Edikasyon an nan kalkil diferans ant revni ak depans Leta yo, men li pa t mete depans FNE yo ladan l. Dapre Koudèkont la, sa te defòme sipli yo te rapòte a, sa vle di lajan ki ta rete apre depans yo.
text.en: Haiti’s audit court identifies this kind of problem in government accounts for fiscal year 2023–2024. Its report says the Finance Ministry counted resources intended for the National Education Fund in the budget balance but left out FNE expenditure. The court says this distorted the reported surplus.

text.ht: Se menm fon edikasyon an ki parèt nan tras frè transfè yo depi 2011. Rapò Koudèkont 2017–2018 la te deja dekri lajan BRH ak CONATEL ranmase epi voye nan Trezò piblik la. Lè nou mete de rapò yo ansanm, yo mennen nou nan yon lòt kesyon: èske kont Leta yo pèmèt piblik la suiv lajan edikasyon an jouk nan depans final yo?
text.en: This is the education fund appearing in the transfer-fee trail since 2011. The court’s 2017–2018 report had already described money collected through the central bank and CONATEL and transferred to the Treasury. Reading the reports together raises a further question: do government accounts let the public follow education money through to its final use?

text.ht: Gen dokiman piblik ki ka ede. Sit FNE a prezante yon lis èd finansye pou 2025–2026, avèk benefisyè, rezon ak montan. Se yon pwen depa pou verifye peman yo. Men yon lis enstitisyon an pibliye poukont li pa ranplase yon odit endepandan oswa verifikasyon sa lekòl yo resevwa.
text.en: There are public records to examine. FNE’s website lists financial assistance for 2025–2026, with beneficiaries, purposes and amounts. It provides a starting point for checking payments. An institution’s own list, however, cannot replace an independent audit or verification of what schools received.

text.ht: Pwoblèm kontab sa a pa pwouve Martelly oswa yon lòt ansyen prezidan te pran lajan an. Rapò ki kouvri 2023–2024 la konsène yon peryòd apre prezidans li. Li montre yon pwomès edikasyon bezwen plis pase chif sou sa Leta ranmase: li bezwen kont ki montre sa Leta fè ak lajan an.
text.en: This accounting problem does not prove that Martelly or another former president took the money. The report for 2023–2024 covers a period after his presidency. It shows why an education promise needs more than collection figures: it needs accounts showing what government did with the money.

title.ht: Claude Joseph ak dosye Moïse la: sa ki chanje depi 2024
title.en: Claude Joseph and the Moïse case: what changed after 2024

description.ht: Pou konprann dosye a, fòk nou suiv ankèt ann Ayiti a ak pwosè Ozetazini yo apa, epi li sa ki rive apre premye akizasyon yo.
description.en: Understanding the case requires following Haiti’s inquiry and the U.S. prosecutions separately, including what happened after the first accusations.

text.ht: Yo te asasinen prezidan Jovenel Moïse lakay li 7 Jiyè 2021. Claude Joseph t ap sèvi kòm Premye minis enterimè nan epòk la. Jodi a, lè n ap egzamine dosye kandida sa a, fòk nou konprann sa lajistis te fè apre asasina a.
text.en: President Jovenel Moïse was assassinated at home on July 7, 2021. Claude Joseph was serving as acting prime minister. Examining this candidate’s record requires understanding what the courts did after the killing.

text.ht: Yon òdonans an 2024 te voye Joseph ak plizyè lòt moun devan tribinal kriminèl sou akizasyon konplisite nan asasina a. Men 13 Oktòb 2025, Koudapèl Pòtoprens te anile ansyen òdonans sa a epi mande yon nouvo ankèt. Se sa Vant Bèf Info te rapòte sou desizyon an.
text.en: A 2024 investigative order referred Joseph and others for criminal trial over alleged complicity in the assassination. But on October 13, 2025, the Port-au-Prince appeals court annulled that earlier order and called for a renewed investigation, according to Vant Bèf Info’s account of the ruling.

text.ht: Sa enpòtan: prezante òdonans 2024 la poukont li ta kite yon gwo chanjman deyò istwa a. Men anilasyon òdonans lan pa menm bagay ak yon jijman ki deklare yon moun pa koupab apre yon pwosè. Desizyon an te mande plis ankèt.
text.en: That matters: presenting the 2024 order alone would leave a major change out of the story. Annulment is also different from an acquittal after trial. The ruling called for further investigation.

text.ht: Rapò BINUH pou Jiyè–Septanm 2026 la konfime jij la te fè lòt odyans nan mwa Jiyè ak Out nan kad ankèt siplemantè a. Kidonk, nouvo ankèt la pa t sèlman yon anons sou papye.
text.en: BINUH’s July–September 2026 report confirms further hearings in July and August as part of that supplementary inquiry. The renewed investigation had therefore advanced beyond an announcement.

text.ht: Ozetazini, se yon lòt pwosedi. Nan mwa Septanm 2026, Depatman Jistis te anonse transfè 18 moun soti Ayiti pou Miami nan yon dosye ki te gen 30 moun akize. BINUH rapòte yo te deja jwenn dis moun koupab Ozetazini nan dat 30 Septanm. Sa pa vle di tout moun yo akize yo te kondane.
text.en: The United States has separate proceedings. In September 2026, the Justice Department announced the transfer of 18 defendants from Haiti to Miami in a case involving 30 indicted people. BINUH reports that ten people had been found guilty in the United States by September 30. That does not mean every accused person was convicted.

text.ht: Gen pwosè ki te toujou ap dewoule apre dat sa a. Yon rapò Jacqueline Charles pou Miami Herald, pibliye 13 Novanm, dekri Christian Emmanuel Sanon k ap temwaye nan pwòp defans li. Se yon rapò sou temwayaj; li pa yon vèdik.
text.en: Proceedings continued beyond that date. A November 13 report by Miami Herald journalist Jacqueline Charles describes Christian Emmanuel Sanon testifying in his own defense. It reports testimony, not a verdict.

text.ht: Akizasyon ak kondanasyon lòt moun pa pwouve Joseph te patisipe nan asasina a. Nenpòt lyen ak yon kandida bezwen pwòp prèv li. Atik sa a mete etap pwosedi yo nan lòd; li pa pretann revele tout moun ki te òganize krim nan.
text.en: Charges and convictions concerning others do not prove Joseph participated in the assassination. Any connection to a candidate needs its own evidence. This article puts the procedural stages in order; it does not claim to identify every organizer of the crime.

title.ht: Apre pwomès lekòl Martelly a, mande kont ki klè
title.en: After Martelly’s school promise, demand clear accounts

description.ht: Pozisyon editoryal nou: yon pwomès pou sèvi timoun dwe vini ak yon fason piblik la ka verifye chak etap lajan an.
description.en: Our editorial position: a promise to serve children should include a way for the public to check each stage of the money trail.

text.ht: Dosye frè transfè yo ban nou de enfòmasyon pou kenbe ansanm. Rapò Koudèkont 2017–2018 la montre lajan te ale nan Trezò piblik la. Rapò pou 2023–2024 la idantifye yon pwoblèm kote resous FNE yo te antre nan kalkil rès lajan bidjè a, men depans li yo pa t antre ladan l.
text.en: The transfer-fee record gives us two facts to hold together. The audit court’s 2017–2018 report records money reaching the Treasury. Its report for 2023–2024 identifies a balance calculation that included FNE resources while leaving out FNE expenditure.

text.ht: Pou nou, sa bay yon egzijans pou chak kandida, kit li gen eksperyans, kit li nouvo: lè yon kandida mande fanmi kontribye pou yon sèvis, li dwe montre kijan yo pral verifye rezilta a.
text.en: For us, that creates a standard for every candidate, whether experienced or new: when asking families to contribute toward a service, show how they will be able to verify the result.

text.ht: Kat repons dwe mache ak chak nouvo pwomès: konbyen lajan ki antre, kiyès ki resevwa l, ki sèvis moun jwenn, epi kiyès ki verifye sa san l pa depann de moun k ap depanse a. Yon foto lekòl pa bay kat repons sa yo.
text.en: Four answers should accompany each new promise: how much comes in, who receives it, what service people get, and who checks this independently of the spender. A photograph of a school cannot supply those four answers.

text.ht: Yon lis benefisyè, tankou sa FNE pibliye pou 2025–2026 la, ka ede nou kòmanse. Men fòk nou ka konpare lis la ak peman yo ak sa benefisyè yo resevwa. Mete dokiman deyò pa vle di tout dokiman yo deja verifye.
text.en: A beneficiary list, such as FNE’s for 2025–2026, can help us begin. But it must be possible to compare the list with payments and what beneficiaries received. Publishing documents does not mean every document has been verified.

text.ht: Se sou kapasite pou bay prèv sa yo nou vle egzamine pwomès yo. Sa pwoteje fanmi ki peye yo, timoun yo ak moun yo ta ka akize san prèv. Rann kont dwe pèmèt nou wè tou sa ki mache byen.
text.en: We want promises examined through the ability to provide this evidence. That protects paying families, children and people who might otherwise face unsupported accusations. Accountability must also let us see what worked.

title.ht: Martelly: ki sa twa entèdiksyon ameriken yo vize?
title.en: Martelly: what do the three U.S. restrictions cover?

description.ht: Dèyè mo « sanksyon » an, gen mezi presi. Fòk nou li yo anvan nou esplike konsekans yo.
description.en: The word “sanctions” covers specific measures. Their actual terms matter.

text.ht: Yon bank ameriken pa ka ba l kredi. Sèten tranzaksyon deviz ak envestisman ameriken ki konsène l entèdi tou. Se twa mezi Trèzò ameriken an te anonse kont Michel Joseph Martelly 20 Out 2024.
text.en: A U.S. bank cannot extend him credit. Certain foreign-exchange transactions and U.S. investments involving him are also prohibited. These are the three measures the U.S. Treasury announced against Michel Joseph Martelly on August 20, 2024.

text.ht: Washington te di ansyen prezidan an te fasilite trafik dwòg, blanchi lajan epi sipòte plizyè gang. Se rezon administrasyon ameriken an bay pou desizyon li; kominike sa a pa yon jijman kriminèl.
text.en: Washington said the former president facilitated drug trafficking, laundered money and sponsored gangs. Those are the U.S. administration’s stated grounds; the announcement is not a criminal judgment.

text.ht: Gen yon detay ki fasil pou rate. OFAC, biwo ameriken ki jere sanksyon finansye yo, te mete Martelly sou lis NS-MBS la, ki pèmèt mezi espesifik. Se pa menm lis ak SDN lan. Non li toujou nan fichye ofisyèl ki konsolide lis ki pa SDN yo nou telechaje 15 Novanm 2026 la.
text.en: One easily missed detail: OFAC, the U.S. financial-sanctions office, placed Martelly on its NS-MBS list of specified measures. This is different from the SDN list. His name remains in the official consolidated non-SDN file downloaded November 15, 2026.

text.ht: Kidonk, yon fraz ki di « Etazini bloke tout byen li » pa esplike mezi sa yo kòrèkteman. Fòk nou nonmen ki tranzaksyon ki entèdi, ki moun règ la konsène ak dat desizyon an. Sa pi presi pase repete yon gwo etikèt.
text.en: A blanket statement that “the U.S. froze all his assets” therefore does not accurately describe these measures. Name the prohibited transactions, who is covered and the decision date. That is more precise than repeating a broad label.

text.ht: Pou lektè k ap egzamine kandidati li, de kesyon rete diferan: ki zak Washington di li te fè, epi ki prèv yon tribinal te egzamine? Yon sanksyon finansye pa reponn toude poukont li.
text.en: For readers examining his candidacy, two questions remain separate: what conduct does Washington attribute to him, and what evidence has a court examined? A financial designation cannot answer both on its own.

title.ht: Martelly ak gang yo: sa rapò ONU a di sou entèmedyè yo
title.en: Martelly and gangs: what the UN report says about intermediaries

description.ht: Rapò 2023 a dekri lajan, zam ak moun ki t ap fè lyen. Se sou chak lyen prèv la dwe chita.
description.en: The 2023 report describes money, weapons and people connecting them. Each link needs its own evidence.

text.ht: Yon politisyen pa bezwen parèt sou yon foto ak yon chèf gang pou yon relasyon gen konsekans. Se youn nan mekanis rapò ekspè ONU 2023 a dekri nan ka Michel Martelly: relasyon ki ta pase atravè entèmedyè, fondasyon ak moun nan sekirite pwòch li.
text.en: A politician need not appear in a photograph with a gang leader for a relationship to matter. One mechanism described in the UN experts’ 2023 report on Michel Martelly is alleged contact through intermediaries, foundations and members of his close-protection team.

text.ht: Nan paragraf 73 ak 74, ekspè yo rapòte ansyen prezidan an te sipòte gang tankou Base 257, Village de Dieu, Ti Bois ak Grand Ravine avèk lajan oswa zam. Yo dekri Base 257 kòm yon zouti pou anpeche manifestasyon kont gouvènman an nan Petyonvil, sitou depi 2014.
text.en: In paragraphs 73 and 74, the experts report support for gangs including Base 257, Village de Dieu, Ti Bois and Grand Ravine through money or firearms. They describe Base 257 as an instrument for preventing anti-government demonstrations in Pétion-Ville, especially from 2014.

text.ht: Rapò a site deklarasyon Arnel Joseph sou kontak li ak yon entèmedyè ki t ap travay nan pwoteksyon Martelly. Li site tou yon videyo kote Ti Lapli pale sou fizi lapolis yo ta bay chèf gang. Sa yo se eleman rapò a prezante; nou pa pretann nou te gen aksè dirèk ak tout temwayaj konfidansyèl ki sèvi kòm baz rapò a.
text.en: The report cites Arnel Joseph’s account of contact with an intermediary in Martelly’s protection unit, and a video in which Ti Lapli discusses police rifles allegedly supplied to gang leaders. These are elements presented by the report; we do not claim independent access to every underlying confidential testimony.

text.ht: Sa fè kesyon an pi presi pase « èske li konnen yon chèf gang? »: kiyès ki te bay resous, kiyès ki te pote yo, pou ki objektif, ak sou lòd kiyès? Se la yon ankèt bezwen non, dat ak tras materyèl.
text.en: This makes the question more precise than whether he knows a gang leader: who supplied resources, who delivered them, for what purpose and on whose instructions? An investigation needs names, dates and material records at each step.

text.ht: Yon rapò ekspè ki nonmen relasyon sa yo merite egzamen serye. Men li pa otorize nou bay tout moun ki te travay bò kote Martelly menm responsablite a, ni prezante tout akizasyon yo kòm kondanasyon tribinal.
text.en: An expert report identifying these relationships warrants serious scrutiny. It does not authorize assigning the same responsibility to everyone who worked near Martelly or presenting every allegation as a court conviction.

title.ht: 54 fizi Palè: kote lyen fanmi rankontre yon fonksyon piblik
title.en: 54 Palace rifles: where a family connection meets public responsibility

description.ht: Rapò ONU a nonmen yon responsab sekirite ak yon relasyon fanmi. Fòk nou egzamine fonksyon an ak tras zam yo ansanm.
description.en: The UN report names a security official and a family connection. The public role and the weapons trail must be examined together.

text.ht: Zam ki fèt pou pwoteje Leta ka vin sèvi kont popilasyon an lè kontwòl sou yo kraze. Rapò ekspè ONU 2024 a bay yon egzanp presi: 54 fizi otomatik Galil lapolis ki te detounen nan depo Palè Nasyonal ant 2013 ak 2016.
text.en: Weapons intended to protect the state can turn against the public when custody controls fail. The UN experts’ 2024 report provides a specific example: 54 police-owned Galil automatic rifles diverted from National Palace stocks between 2013 and 2016.

text.ht: Nan paragraf 80, rapò a di Pierre-Léon Junior Saint Remy te responsab sekirite Palè a ak jesyon depo zam li pandan peryòd sa a. Ekspè yo dekri li kòm yon fanmi pwòch madanm prezidan Michel Martelly. Relasyon sa a enpòtan paske li mache ak yon fonksyon piblik ki te gen kontwòl sou zam.
text.en: Paragraph 80 identifies Pierre-Léon Junior Saint Remy as responsible for Palace security and management of its weapons stockpile during that period. The experts describe him as a close relative of President Michel Martelly’s wife. The relationship matters because it accompanies a public role with responsibility for weapons.

text.ht: Paj ki vin apre a pa dwe rete deyò istwa a: enfòmasyon ekspè yo te resevwa endike fizi yo te ale bay moun, ladan yo manm gang, an echanj pou sipò bay prezidan an. Rapò a di kèk nan zam yo te jwenn apre sou sèn krim oswa nan men manm gang ann Ayiti ak aletranje.
text.en: The next page is essential: information supplied to the experts indicates the rifles went to individuals, including gang members, in exchange for support for the president. The report says some were subsequently recovered at crime scenes or from gang members in Haiti and abroad.

text.ht: Rapò a dekri tou yon feblès ki pi laj: lidèchip lapolis pa t kapab fè envantè depo Palè a pandan plizyè ane. Kidonk, sijè a pa sèlman kiyès ki te pwòch kiyès. Se kiyès ki te kenbe rejis yo, otorize sòti yo epi verifye sa ki te rete.
text.en: The report also describes a wider weakness: police leadership had been unable to inventory Palace stocks for years. The issue therefore extends beyond personal proximity to who kept the records, authorized transfers and checked what remained.

text.ht: Relasyon fanmi a poukont li pa pwouve Martelly oswa madanm li te bay yon lòd. Pou etabli responsablite pèsonèl, fòk gen lòt prèv. Men fonksyon sekirite a ak kantite zam yo bay yon pwen depa ki konkrè pou mande kont.
text.en: Kinship alone does not prove Martelly or his wife issued an order. Personal responsibility requires further evidence. The security role and specified weapons, however, provide a concrete starting point for accountability.

title.ht: Martelly nan dosye lobbying lan: kiyès ki peye?
title.en: Martelly’s lobbying file: who is paying?

description.ht: Yon depo ameriken rapòte 75,000 dola resevwa; kontra a prevwa lòt montan. Se pa menm bagay.
description.en: A U.S. filing reports $75,000 received; the contract specifies other amounts. Those are different facts.

text.ht: Nan yon dosye depoze Washington 5 Novanm 2026, Liberty Government Affairs deklare li resevwa 75,000 dola nan men Invisible Investigations LLC. Dat resi a se 10 Septanm. Moun etranje travay la fèt pou li a se Michel Joseph Martelly, atravè menm konpayi entèmedyè sa a.
text.en: In a filing submitted in Washington on November 5, 2026, Liberty Government Affairs reports receiving $75,000 from Invisible Investigations LLC. The receipt is dated September 10. The foreign principal served by the work is Michel Joseph Martelly, through that intermediary company.

text.ht: Dosye a nan rejis FARA, ki fè relasyon sèten ajan ak kliyan etranje yo piblik. Sa etabli yon relasyon sèvis ki deklare. Li pa yon akizasyon koripsyon oswa yon prèv DOJ verifye chak deklarasyon finansye.
text.en: The disclosure is in the FARA register, which makes certain agents’ relationships with foreign principals public. It establishes a disclosed service relationship, not a corruption charge or proof that DOJ independently audited every financial declaration.

text.ht: Kontra ki tache a gen dat 22 Oktòb, ak siyati 26 Oktòb. Li prevwa yon depo 125,000 dola, yon frè 50,000 dola pa mwa ak depans ki limite nòmalman a 5,000 dola pa mwa. Kontra a di li ranplase tout ansyen akò. Nou pa dwe prezante montan kontra sa yo kòm lajan ki deja peye.
text.en: The attached letter is dated October 22 and signed October 26. It specifies a $125,000 deposit, a $50,000 monthly retainer and expenses normally capped at $5,000 monthly. It says it supersedes prior agreements. These terms must not be presented as amounts already paid.

text.ht: Gen yon lòt detay enpòtan. Kontra a di Martelly pa dwe ranbouse oswa rekonpanse Invisible Investigations, dirèkteman oswa endirèkteman, pou frè sa yo. Li prevwa peman davans avèk dola ki deja nan enstitisyon finansye ameriken. Se kondisyon kontra yo; yo pa poukont yo prèv sou orijin final tout lajan an.
text.en: Another important detail: the agreement says Martelly must not directly or indirectly reimburse or compensate Invisible Investigations for these payments. It calls for advance payments using dollars already held at U.S. financial institutions. These are contractual conditions, not independent proof of the ultimate origin of all funds.

text.ht: Kesyon ki rete a se presi: ki relasyon finansye ki soutni entèmedyè a, epi kijan resi 75,000 dola a mache ak nouvo kondisyon kontra yo? Dosye nou li a pa bay ase enfòmasyon pou reponn tout sa. Li pa pèmèt envante yon finansè kache.
text.en: The remaining question is specific: what financial relationships support the intermediary, and how does the $75,000 receipt relate to the newer contract terms? The filing reviewed does not supply enough information to answer everything. It does not justify inventing a hidden financier.

title.ht: Sa kontra lobbying Martelly a mande Washington chanje
title.en: What Martelly’s lobbying contract asks Washington to change

description.ht: Dokiman an vize politik sanksyon. Li pa yon vèdik, ni yon pwomès rezilta.
description.en: The document targets sanctions policy. It is neither a verdict nor a promise of success.

text.ht: Kontra ki parèt nan dosye FARA 7793 a mande konsèy ak demach enfliyans bò kote Trèzò ameriken an ak Depatman Deta, sou politik ki sèvi ak OFAC pou sanksyone moun etranje. Sa bay yon objektif politik piblik ki presi pou travay la.
text.en: The agreement in FARA filing 7793 calls for advice and advocacy aimed at the U.S. Treasury and State Department concerning policy that uses OFAC to sanction foreign individuals. This gives the work a specific public-policy target.

text.ht: Invisible Investigations se kliyan ki siyen kontra a; Michel Joseph Martelly se benefisyè li nonmen. Lèt la prezante travay la kòm yon efò pou revize politik oswa desizyon ki, dapre pozisyon kliyan an, pa ta gen ase baz nan prèv oswa lalwa. Sa se objektif kliyan an, pa yon konklizyon administrasyon ameriken an dakò avè l.
text.en: Invisible Investigations is the contracting client; Michel Joseph Martelly is the named beneficiary. The letter frames the work as seeking review of policies or designations considered insufficiently grounded in facts or law. That is the client’s position, not a finding that the U.S. government agrees.

text.ht: Sèvis yo gen ladan prepare estrateji, kominike ak responsab gouvènman yo epi bay rapò sou avansman travay la. Men kontra a pa garanti menm yon rankont, yon chanjman politik oswa leve sanksyon yo. Li kite posibilite pou sispann travay ki ta poze pwoblèm legal.
text.en: Services include developing strategies, communicating with officials and reporting progress. The agreement guarantees neither a meeting, a policy change nor removal of sanctions. It permits suspension of work that raises legal concerns.

text.ht: Yon lòt limit ekri klèman: sèvis sa yo pa kouvri travay nan litij, dosye kriminèl oswa ankèt Kongrè, sof si gen yon lòt akò alekri. Kidonk, dosye lobbying sa a pa prèv konpayi an reprezante Martelly nan nenpòt dosye tribinal sou asasina Jovenel Moïse.
text.en: Another express limit: services exclude litigation, criminal matters and congressional investigations unless separately agreed in writing. This lobbying filing therefore does not establish that the firm represents Martelly in court proceedings concerning Jovenel Moïse’s assassination.

text.ht: Pou suiv rezilta travay la, fòk nou chèche kontak oswa aktivite ki deklare pita ak nenpòt desizyon ofisyèl OFAC. Egzistans yon kontra pa sifi pou di yon responsab ameriken te aksepte rankontre kliyan an oswa chanje pozisyon li.
text.en: Assessing results requires later disclosures of contacts or activities and any official OFAC decision. A contract alone cannot establish that a U.S. official agreed to a meeting or changed position.

title.ht: Gary Bodeau: lè yon vòt pou nominasyon ta gen yon pri
title.en: Gary Bodeau: when an appointment vote allegedly had a price

description.ht: Trèzò ameriken an dekri lajan pou enfliyanse vòt nan Chanm depite a. Bodeau rejte akizasyon yo.
description.en: The U.S. Treasury describes payments intended to influence votes in the Chamber of Deputies. Bodeau disputes the allegations.

text.ht: Yon moun ki bezwen apwobasyon depite yo pou antre nan gouvènman ta dwe jwenn yon vòt sou kapasite ak pwojè li. Nan dosye Gary Bodeau a, Trèzò ameriken an dekri yon lòt lojik: lajan ta sikile pou fè rezilta nominasyon yo mache nan yon sans.
text.en: Someone seeking parliamentary approval for a government appointment should face scrutiny of their ability and plans. In Gary Bodeau’s case, the U.S. Treasury describes another mechanism: money allegedly circulating to secure an appointment outcome.

text.ht: Nan desizyon 5 Avril 2023 li a, administrasyon ameriken an di ansyen prezidan Chanm depite a te patisipe nan plizyè plan koripsyon. Li rapòte peman bay responsab ayisyen an 2018 pou jwenn vòt, epi diskisyon sou peman pou yon lòt vòt nominasyon an 2019.
text.en: In its April 5, 2023 action, the U.S. administration says the former Chamber president participated in corruption schemes. It describes payments to Haitian officials to secure votes in 2018 and discussions about payments for another appointment vote in 2019.

text.ht: Pou epizòd 2019 la, Trèzò a site ant 500 ak 600 milyon goud kèk biznisman te bay manm Chanm nan. Li pa di tout montan sa a te antre nan pòch pèsonèl Bodeau. Fòk nou kenbe diferans sa a lè n ap rakonte akizasyon an.
text.en: For the 2019 episode, Treasury identifies 500–600 million gourdes supplied by businessmen to Chamber members. It does not say this entire amount entered Bodeau’s personal pocket. That distinction matters when describing the allegation.

text.ht: Bodeau te reyaji piblikman apre sanksyon an. Dapre Gazette Haïti, li te di li pa t fè anyen pou merite sa, epi li te anonse li vle sèvi ak mekanis legal Ozetazini ak Kanada pou konteste akizasyon yo. Anonse yon demach pa menm bagay ak montre desizyon ki soti ladan l.
text.en: Bodeau responded publicly after the designation. Gazette Haïti reports that he denied having done anything to deserve it and said he intended to use U.S. and Canadian legal mechanisms to contest the allegations. An announced challenge is different from a documented ruling on it.

text.ht: Sanksyon sa a se yon desizyon administratif ameriken, pa yon kondanasyon nan yon pwosè kriminèl. Fraz Trèzò a sou koripsyon ki ranfòse gang yo pa dwe tounen yon fo deklarasyon tribinal te kondane Bodeau pou finanse gang.
text.en: The sanction is a U.S. administrative decision, not a criminal-trial conviction. Treasury’s statement that corruption empowers gangs must not become a false claim that a court convicted Bodeau of financing gangs.

text.ht: Pou eleksyon an, kesyon enstitisyonèl la klè: si nominasyon depann de peman prive, kiyès moun ki pran fonksyon an pral dwe sèvis apre sa? Se resi, mesaj ak dosye vòt ki ka pèmèt teste chèn sa a, pa etikèt sèlman.
text.en: The institutional question is clear: if appointments depend on private payments, to whom will the appointee owe favors afterward? Receipts, communications and voting records can test that chain; labels alone cannot.

title.ht: Muscadin: pwoteksyon popilasyon an ak 76 ka ONU dokimante yo
title.en: Muscadin: public protection and the 76 cases documented by the UN

description.ht: Sipò pou yon responsab sekirite ak prèv sou metòd li yo se de kesyon diferan.
description.en: Support for a security official and evidence about his methods are different questions.

text.ht: Moun k ap viv anba menas gang vle pwoteksyon. Nan Miragwàn, plizyè dizèn manifestan te soti soutni Jean Ernest Muscadin an Novanm 2025, dapre Vant Bèf Info. Gen patisipan ki te prezante pwokirè a kòm yon moun ki fè fas ak gang yo kote enstitisyon yo pa rive pwoteje yo.
text.en: People living under gang threats want protection. In Miragoâne, several dozen demonstrators supported Jean Ernest Muscadin in November 2025, according to Vant Bèf Info. Participants portrayed the prosecutor as confronting gangs where institutions had failed to protect them.

text.ht: Men gen yon dosye ki dwe antre nan egzamen kandidati li tou. Nan rapò Avril–Jen 2026 li a, BINUH di pa t gen pwosedi lajistis kont Muscadin pou patisipasyon posib li nan omwen 76 egzekisyon somè ki dokimante ant 2022 ak 2025. Se touye moun san pwosesis lajistis ki ta dwe detèmine koupabilite yo.
text.en: His candidacy also requires examining another record. In its April–June 2026 report, BINUH says no judicial proceedings had been initiated against Muscadin for possible involvement in at least 76 summary executions documented between 2022 and 2025: killings outside the judicial process meant to determine guilt.

text.ht: Dat yo enpòtan. Chif 76 la pa kantite moun ki mouri nan dezyèm trimès 2026 la. Li konsène ka ant 2022 ak 2025. Yon rapò ekspè 2025 te deja site omwen 74 ka jiska Jen ane sa a. Nou pa ajoute 74 sou 76 kòm si se de gwoup moun ki diferan.
text.en: The dates matter. The 76 is not a death toll for the second quarter of 2026. It concerns cases from 2022–2025. A 2025 expert report had identified at least 74 cases through June that year. We do not add 74 to 76 as if they were separate groups.

text.ht: Sa yo se akizasyon ak konsta rapò ONU yo, pa yon vèdik kriminèl. Absans pwosedi nan peryòd rapò a pa pwouve akizasyon yo fo; li pa pwouve yo vre tou. Menm jan an, yon manifestasyon sipò pa yon sondaj ki mezire opinyon tout popilasyon an.
text.en: These are allegations and observations in UN reports, not a criminal verdict. The reported absence of proceedings proves neither that the allegations are false nor that they are true. A supporting demonstration is likewise not a representative opinion poll.

text.ht: Kesyon ki dwe mache ak pwomès sekirite a se konkrè: kiyès ki verifye idantite ak aksyon moun yon responsab rele bandi? Ki sa fanmi yo ka fè si gen yon erè? Pwoteje popilasyon an mande repons sou rezilta ak sou limit pouvwa a.
text.en: The questions accompanying a security promise are concrete: who verifies the identity and conduct of people an official calls criminals? What recourse exists if there is an error? Public protection requires answers about results and limits on power.

title.ht: Privert ak Kanada: kisa desizyon sanksyon an etabli?
title.en: Privert and Canada: what does the sanctions record establish?

description.ht: Lis la konfime desizyon administratif la. Li pa ranplase yon dosye prèv sou chak zak yo reproche.
description.en: The list confirms an administrative designation. It does not replace evidence about each alleged act.

text.ht: Jocelerme Privert parèt sou lis sanksyon Kanada ki konsène Ayiti. Lis konsolide nou verifye 15 Novanm 2026 la bay dat 15 Fevriye 2023 pou antre li a. Sa se yon desizyon reyèl ki dokimante, pa yon rimè sou rezo sosyal.
text.en: Jocelerme Privert appears on Canada’s Haiti sanctions list. The consolidated list checked November 15, 2026 dates his entry to February 15, 2023. This is a documented administrative action, not a social-media rumor.

text.ht: Nan eksplikasyon amannman sa a, Kanada di li te ajoute de moun pou gwo zak koripsyon ki alimante kriz la. Eksplikasyon kolektif la site gwo fwod, move jesyon lajan piblik ak trafik zam kòm kalite aktivite ki konsène gwoup sa a. Li pa bay, nan pasaj sa a, yon lis tranzaksyon endividyèl ki ta pwouve chak aktivite sa yo pou Privert.
text.en: Canada’s explanation says the amendment added two people over significant corruption fueling the crisis. Its collective explanation mentions large-scale fraud, public-fund mismanagement and arms trafficking. That passage does not provide an itemized transaction record establishing every category of conduct for Privert individually.

text.ht: Se la presizyon fè diferans: « Kanada sanksyone Privert » se yon enfòmasyon lis la konfime. « Yon tribinal kondane Privert pou chak zak sa yo » se yon lòt deklarasyon, ki bezwen yon jijman. Lis la pa bay sa.
text.en: Precision changes the meaning: “Canada sanctioned Privert” is confirmed by the list. “A court convicted Privert of each of those acts” is a different claim requiring a judgment. The list does not supply that.

text.ht: Privert te konteste desizyon an. Nan yon entèvansyon LE POINT Gazette Haïti rapòte 8 Mas 2023, li te rejte sanksyon yo epi deklare li pa gen enterè oswa byen nan Kanada. Se deklarasyon pa l; nou pa prezante li kòm yon odit byen li.
text.en: Privert disputed the action. In a LE POINT appearance reported by Gazette Haïti on March 8, 2023, he rejected the sanctions and said he had no interests or assets in Canada. That is his statement, not an independent audit of his holdings.

text.ht: Pou egzamine dosye a pi lwen, fòk nou chèche zak presi, dokiman finansye ak nenpòt repons lajistis ki vin apre. Egzijans sa a pa efase sanksyon an. Li anpeche yon desizyon administratif sèvi kòm yon istwa nou ajoute detay ladan l san prèv.
text.en: Further scrutiny requires specific acts, financial records and any subsequent judicial response. That requirement does not erase the designation. It prevents an administrative action from becoming a story embellished with unsupported details.

title.ht: Etzer Emile vle double lapolis. Ki lè rekrit yo ap pare?
title.en: Etzer Emile wants to double the police. When will recruits be ready?

description.ht: Gen yon diferans ant anonse fòmasyon ak mete yon polisye byen prepare nan lari.
description.en: Announcing training and putting a prepared officer on the street are different steps.

text.ht: Yon fanmi bezwen konnen si wout lakay li ap an sekirite, pa sèlman kantite moun yon kandida vle rekrite. Pwogram Etzer Emile a vize pase soti nan anviwon 13 000 polisye operasyonèl rive nan 26 000 an 2033. Se chif depa kanpay la bay.
text.en: A family needs to know whether its road will be safe, not only how many people a candidate wants to recruit. Etzer Emile’s programme proposes moving from about 13,000 operational officers to 26,000 by 2033. That starting figure is the campaign’s.

text.ht: Pou premye 100 jou yo, li pwomèt akselere rekritman ak fòmasyon 1 000 a 2 000 polisye. Paj la prevwa tou verifikasyon rekrit yo, sanksyon kont abi ak yon enspeksyon jeneral ranfòse.
text.en: For the first 100 days, he promises to accelerate recruitment and training of 1,000–2,000 officers. The page also proposes recruit screening, sanctions for abuse and a stronger inspectorate.

text.ht: Mo « akselere » a enpòtan. Li pa vle di tout rekrit sa yo ap fin fòme nan santyèm jou a. Yon kalandriye ki montre kantite ki antre, kantite ki fini epi kantite ki rete nan sèvis ta pèmèt piblik la mezire pwomès la.
text.en: The word “accelerate” matters. It does not mean all those recruits would finish training by day 100. A timetable showing entrants, graduates and officers retained in service would let the public measure delivery.

text.ht: Menm kantite rekrit la ka bay de rezilta diferan. Si yo ranplase polisye ki kite sèvis la, fòs la ka prèske pa grandi. Si yo ajoute sou ekip ki deja la yo, gen plis moun pou pwoteje zòn yo. Kont lan dwe montre toude mouvman yo.
text.en: The same recruitment total can produce two different results. If recruits replace departing officers, the force may barely grow. If they add to existing teams, more officers become available. The count must show both movements.

text.ht: Pou yon moun sou wout la, mezi ki konte a se prezans ki dire: kiyès ki peye ekip la, kiyès ki kontwole konduit li, epi èske li toujou la apre operasyon an? Se la yon plan rekritman vin yon plan pwoteksyon.
text.en: For someone travelling, the meaningful test is sustained protection: who pays the unit, who supervises its conduct, and does it remain after an operation? That is where a recruitment plan becomes a protection plan.

title.ht: Etzer Emile ak 30 milya dola yo: kiyès ki pote lajan an?
title.en: Etzer Emile’s $30 billion plan: who provides the money?

description.ht: Yon total bay gwosè yon pwomès. Sous lajan an montre kiyès ki pran risk la.
description.en: A total shows the scale of a promise. Funding sources show who carries the risk.

text.ht: Sou sit kanpay li a, Etzer Emile prezante yon pwogram 30 milya dola ameriken sou senk ane. Paj enfrastrikti a rezève 15 milya dola pou sektè sa a: mwatye total la. Sa yo se anvlòp pwopoze, pa lajan nou verifye ki deja disponib.
text.en: Etzer Emile’s campaign website presents a US$30 billion programme over five years. Its infrastructure page assigns US$15 billion to that sector: half the total. These are proposed envelopes, not funds we have verified as available.

text.ht: Divize 30 milya pa senk bay yon mwayèn 6 milya dola chak ane. Se kalkil nou sou total la. Sa pa vle di depans yo ta menm chak ane; yon gwo chantye ka mande plis lajan nan kòmansman.
text.en: Dividing 30 billion by five gives an average of US$6 billion a year. That is our calculation from the stated total. It does not imply equal annual spending; a large project may require more funding at the start.

text.ht: Men yon lòt diferans pi enpòtan. Yon don pa menm ak yon prè leta dwe remèt. Envestisman prive ka pote kondisyon sou tarif oswa sou pwofi. Revni taks mande yon plan pou ranmase yo. Mete tout sa ansanm anba mo « finansman » kache chwa fanmi yo ap viv ak yo.
text.en: A more important distinction follows. A grant differs from a loan the state must repay. Private investment may come with tariff or profit conditions. Tax revenue requires a collection plan. Grouping these under “funding” can hide choices households will live with.

text.ht: Yon tablo finansman ta dwe bay, pou chak pwojè, pri an goud ak an dola, sous ki konfime, montan ki poko jwenn ak dèt ki ta rete. San tablo sa a, lektè a pa ka wè diferans ant anbisyon ak angajman ki finanse.
text.en: A financing table should give each project’s cost in gourdes and dollars, confirmed sources, unfunded amount and resulting debt. Without it, a reader cannot distinguish ambition from funded commitments.

text.ht: Se pa gwosè chif la poukont li ki fè yon plan serye oswa enposib. Se si lajan an, kalandriye a ak sèvis la mache ansanm. Yon wout fini san antretyen ka tounen yon lòt bòdwo pou menm piblik la.
text.en: The size of the number alone makes a plan neither sound nor impossible. Funding, timing and service must fit together. A completed road without maintenance can become another bill for the same public.

title.ht: Etzer Emile: 500 megawat pa sifi pou esplike bòdwo kouran an
title.en: Etzer Emile: 500 megawatts does not explain the electricity bill

description.ht: Pou mezire pwomès la, suiv kouran an soti nan santral la rive lakay moun.
description.en: To assess the promise, follow power from the plant to the household.

text.ht: Pwogram enfrastrikti Etzer Emile a anonse 500 megawat nouvo kapasite an 2033. Li pale tou de refòm EDH, reparasyon rezo a ak ti rezo solè. Objektif paj la se fè sèvis kouran an pase rive nan 18 èdtan pa jou.
text.en: Etzer Emile’s infrastructure programme proposes 500 megawatts of additional capacity by 2033. It also discusses EDH reform, network repairs and solar mini-grids. The page sets an ambition of 18 hours of daily electricity service.

text.ht: Yon megawat mezire kapasite pou pwodui kouran. Li pa di konbyen èdtan yon kay resevwa l. Yon santral ka gen kapasite sou papye pandan yon liy kraze anpeche kouran an rive nan katye a. Sa esplike poukisa de chif yo pa ka ranplase youn lòt.
text.en: A megawatt measures power capacity. It does not tell us how many hours a household receives electricity. A plant can have capacity on paper while a broken line prevents supply reaching a neighbourhood. The two numbers cannot substitute for each other.

text.ht: Pou yon ti machann ki bezwen kenbe manje fre, twa bagay mache ansanm: èske kouran an rive, èske li dire, epi èske li ka peye l? Yon bon rapò sou plan an dwe montre sèvis ak pri, pa sèlman foto nouvo ekipman.
text.en: For a small trader keeping food cold, three questions belong together: does power arrive, does it last, and is it affordable? Reporting on the plan should track service and price, beyond photographs of new equipment.

text.ht: Fòk chak pwojè gen yon kote, yon dat koneksyon, yon pri ak yon moun ki responsab antretyen. Fòk plan an esplike tou kiyès ki peye lè kliyan pa kapab peye tout pri a. Sib nasyonal la ta dwe desann nan yon lis zòn moun ka rekonèt.
text.en: Each project needs a location, connection date, cost and maintenance responsibility. The plan should also explain who pays when customers cannot cover the full cost. A national target should become a list of places people can recognize.

text.ht: Kesyon desizif la senp: nan ki mwa, nan ki komin, yon fanmi ap jwenn plis èdtan kouran pou yon pri li konnen davans? Se konsa yon kantite megawat vin yon sèvis piblik moun ka evalye.
text.en: The decisive question is simple: in which month and commune will a household receive more hours of power at a price known in advance? That turns a megawatt total into a public service people can assess.

title.ht: Etzer Emile: 5 000 ti pwojè yo vle di 5 milya goud
title.en: Etzer Emile: 5,000 small projects mean 5 billion gourdes

description.ht: Kalkil la fasil. Chwazi benefisyè yo san paspouki se gwo tès la.
description.en: The arithmetic is simple. Choosing beneficiaries fairly is the harder test.

text.ht: Yon milyon goud ka chanje sa yon ti antrepriz kapab fè. Etzer Emile pwopoze prè san enterè ak yon fon garanti pou 5 000 pwojè, ak 1 milyon goud pou chak pwojè. Paj travay kanpay li a mete mezi sa a nan premye 100 jou yo.
text.en: One million gourdes could change what a small business can do. Etzer Emile proposes interest-free loans and a guarantee fund for 5,000 projects, at 1 million gourdes each. His campaign’s jobs page places the measure in its first 100 days.

text.ht: Miltiplikasyon an bay 5 milya goud. Se valè 5 000 prè yo si chak pwojè resevwa montan sa a; li pa otomatikman tout depans leta. Depans administrasyon, garanti ak prè ki pa remèt yo ta dwe parèt apa.
text.en: Multiplication gives 5 billion gourdes. That is the value of 5,000 loans if each receives that amount; it is not automatically the state’s total expenditure. Administration, guarantees and unpaid loans should appear separately.

text.ht: Yon fon garanti ka ankouraje yon bank bay prè lè li pè pèdi lajan. Men garanti a pa lajan gratis: si moun pa remèt prè a, yon lòt moun pran pèt la. Règ pwogram nan dwe di ki pati bank la, leta ak moun ki prete a chak pran.
text.en: A guarantee fund can encourage a bank to lend when it fears losses. A guarantee is not free money: if a borrower fails to repay, someone bears the loss. The rules should specify the shares carried by bank, state and borrower.

text.ht: Lektè a ta dwe kapab jwenn kritè seleksyon yo, kantite pwojè pa depatman, kondisyon ranbousman ak règ pou fanmi responsab politik yo. Yon lis non poukont li pa montre si yon moun te chwazi poutèt pwojè li oswa poutèt kontak li.
text.en: Readers should be able to find selection criteria, projects by department, repayment terms and rules for political officials’ relatives. A list of names alone cannot show whether someone was selected for a project or for connections.

text.ht: Kanpay la pwomèt tou 50 000 djòb tanporè nan travay piblik ak 300 000 djòb fòmèl an 2033. Sa yo pa twa fason pou konte menm rezilta a. Yon prè se yon zouti, yon travay tanporè gen yon fen, epi yon djòb ki dire mande kliyan ak revni.
text.en: The campaign also proposes 50,000 temporary public-works jobs and 300,000 formal jobs by 2033. These are not three ways to count the same outcome. A loan is a tool, temporary work ends, and a lasting job needs customers and revenue.

title.ht: Etzer Emile ak bidjè lekòl la: 16% ak 22% pa konte menm bagay
title.en: Etzer Emile’s school budget: 16% and 22% measure different things

description.ht: Lajan yo otorize sou papye pa toujou egal lajan ki rive nan sèvis la.
description.en: Money authorized on paper does not always equal money delivered to a service.

text.ht: Nan pwogram edikasyon li a, Etzer Emile bay de sib: edikasyon ta resevwa 16% depans piblik ki fèt toutbon an 2029, epi 22% bidjè nasyonal la an 2033. Premye chif la pale de egzekisyon; dezyèm nan pale de bidjè.
text.en: Etzer Emile’s education programme gives two targets: education would receive 16% of public spending actually executed in 2029, and 22% of the national budget in 2033. The first concerns execution; the second concerns the budget.

text.ht: Pou yon paran, sa ka sanble menm pwomès la. Men yon bidjè se otorizasyon depans. Egzekisyon se sa ki depanse toutbon. Si leta otorize 22 goud sou chak 100 pou lekòl, men li pa lage lajan an, pousantaj sou papye a pa peye pwofesè a.
text.en: For a parent, these may sound like the same promise. A budget authorizes expenditure; execution records spending that occurs. If the state authorizes 22 of every 100 gourdes for schools but does not release the money, the paper percentage cannot pay a teacher.

text.ht: Gen yon egzanp sou difikilte pou suiv depans yo: nan rapò sou ane fiskal 2023–2024 la, Lakou Siperyè Kont te kritike fason revni FNE te antre nan bilan leta pandan depans li yo pa t ladan l. Sa pa pwouve pwomès Etzer la enposib; li montre poukisa definisyon ak kont yo enpòtan.
text.en: An example of the tracking problem appears in the state audit for fiscal 2023–2024: the Court of Accounts criticized inclusion of FNE revenue in the government balance while its expenditure was omitted. This does not prove Etzer’s promise impossible; it shows why definitions and accounts matter.

text.ht: Pou konpare 2029 ak 2033, kanpay la ta dwe bay toude mezi yo pou chak ane: montan otorize, montan debouse ak montan depanse. Fòk li di ki enstitisyon ki ladan l, pou yon chanjman nan kontablite pa sanble yon pwogrè nan klas yo.
text.en: To compare 2029 with 2033, the campaign should give both measures each year: amounts authorized, released and spent. It should name the institutions included, so an accounting change cannot masquerade as classroom progress.

text.ht: Finalman, yon paran ap chèche yon pwofesè ki prezan, yon lekòl ki louvri ak yon frè li ka peye. Pousantaj la itil sèlman si piblik la ka suiv chemen lajan an rive nan rezilta sa yo.
text.en: Ultimately, a parent wants a teacher present, an open school and affordable fees. The percentage helps only when the public can trace the money to those outcomes.

title.ht: Olivier Barrau: soti nan asirans fanmi an rive nan anbisyon prezidansyèl
title.en: Olivier Barrau: from a family insurance business to presidential ambition

description.ht: Yon istwa antrepriz ka esplike yon pakou. Li pa ranplase kont sou enterè ekonomik yo.
description.en: A business history can explain a career. It cannot replace an account of financial interests.

text.ht: Nan paj 20 rapò anyèl AIC 2022 a, konpayi an rakonte Olivier Barrau te reprann direksyon koutye asirans fanmi an apre etid li. Menm paj la idantifye Lucien Barrau kòm papa li epi date kreyasyon AIC an Desanm 2001.
text.en: On page 20 of its 2022 annual report, AIC says Olivier Barrau took over management of the family insurance brokerage after his studies. The same page identifies Lucien Barrau as his father and dates AIC’s creation to December 2001.

text.ht: Sa bay yon lyen fanmi ki dokimante nan sous antrepriz la. Li pa bay yon lis konplè byen fanmi an, ni prèv yon favè leta. Nou pa ajoute granparan, parenn oswa patisipasyon finansye sous la pa etabli.
text.en: This provides a family relationship documented by the company. It does not provide a complete family-asset list or evidence of state favour. We do not add grandparents, godparents or financial holdings the source does not establish.

text.ht: Kesyon piblik la kòmanse lè yon dirijan ekonomik vle pran desizyon pou tout peyi a. Ki patisipasyon li toujou genyen? Ki responsablite li kite? Ki desizyon sou asirans, taks oswa kontra piblik li ta dwe kite lòt moun pran pou evite pwòp enterè li enfliyanse yo?
text.en: The public question begins when a business leader seeks power to make decisions for the country. What holdings remain? Which responsibilities have ended? Which insurance, tax or procurement decisions should be left to others to prevent personal interests influencing them?

text.ht: Yon moun ka gen eksperyans itil nan antrepriz epi gen bezwen mete baryè ant byen prive ak fonksyon piblik. De bagay sa yo ka vre ansanm. Yon deklarasyon byen ak yon plan pou jere konfli enterè ta pèmèt lektè yo egzamine baryè sa yo.
text.en: Business experience can be useful while safeguards between private assets and public office remain necessary. Both can be true. An asset declaration and conflict-management plan would let readers examine those safeguards.

text.ht: Istwa papa a itil pou konprann orijin yon aktivite. Pou evalye yon prezidans, se sa kandida a kontwole jodi a ak règ li aksepte pou demen ki mande plis limyè.
text.en: A father’s business history helps explain an activity’s origins. Assessing a presidency requires closer scrutiny of what the candidate controls today and the rules he accepts for tomorrow.

title.ht: Olivier Barrau ak AIC: 2 milyon dola BID la pa t yon don kanpay
title.en: Olivier Barrau and AIC: the IDB’s $2 million was not a campaign gift

description.ht: Dosye prè 2012 la montre yon relasyon finansye presi, ak yon objektif pou egzamine.
description.en: The 2012 loan record identifies a specific financial relationship and purpose to examine.

text.ht: Nan rejis BID la, pwojè HA-L1072 se yon prè 2 milyon dola ameriken pou Alternative Insurance Company. Li te apwouve 8 Mas 2012 nan yon operasyon total 8 milyon dola. Rejis la klase l kòm finansman sektè prive san garanti leta.
text.en: In the IDB register, project HA-L1072 is a US$2 million loan to Alternative Insurance Company. Approved March 8, 2012, it formed part of an US$8 million operation. The register classifies it as non-sovereign-guaranteed private-sector financing.

text.ht: Yon dokiman BID sou objektif la esplike rekapitalizasyon an te dwe ede AIC elaji asirans pou moun ki gen ti revni apre tranblemanntè 2010 la. Rapò anyèl konpayi an idantifye Olivier Barrau kòm direktè jeneral li an 2022.
text.en: An IDB description says recapitalization was intended to help AIC expand insurance for lower-income people after the 2010 earthquake. The company’s annual report identifies Olivier Barrau as its chief executive in 2022.

text.ht: Twa bagay pa dwe melanje: prè yon enstitisyon bay yon konpayi, byen pèsonèl yon kandida ak lajan kanpay li. Dosye sa a dokimante premye a. Li pa fè lajan an tounen yon don pèsonèl oswa yon kontribisyon elektoral.
text.en: Three things should stay separate: an institution’s loan to a company, a candidate’s personal assets and campaign money. This record documents the first. It does not turn the funds into a personal gift or election contribution.

text.ht: Men gen yon kesyon ki merite fouye: èske objektif sosyal operasyon an te rive jwenn moun li te vize yo? Pou reponn, fòk nou konpare kantite moun ki te jwenn asirans, pri yo te peye ak reklamasyon konpayi an te regle. Yon objektif nan yon dokiman pa mezire rezilta sa yo.
text.en: A worthwhile question remains: did the operation’s social purpose reach its intended customers? Answering requires comparing coverage, premiums and claims paid. A purpose statement cannot measure those outcomes.

text.ht: Sa se yon tès pi itil pase prezante tout kontak ak yon bank entènasyonal kòm yon sispisyon. Lè yon kandida sèvi ak eksperyans antrepriz li kòm agiman, piblik la ka egzamine kiyès aktivite sa a te sèvi ak ki rezilta li te bay.
text.en: This is more useful than treating every international-bank relationship as suspicious. When a candidate presents business experience as a qualification, the public can examine whom that activity served and what it delivered.

title.ht: Kò jèn Olivier Barrau a: kiyès ki chwazi, kiyès ki peye?
title.en: Olivier Barrau’s youth corps: who selects and who pays?

description.ht: Yon aktivite fondasyon pa menm ak yon sèvis nasyonal ki dwe sèvi tout sitwayen.
description.en: A foundation event differs from a national service that must serve all citizens.

text.ht: An Septanm 2026, Fondasyon AIC te òganize yon fòmasyon pou jèn nan Jakmèl. Yon mwa apre, Juno7 te rapòte Olivier Barrau pwopoze yon kò jèn pou moun 16–35 an: yon pwogram pilòt twa ane sou sèvis kominotè, espò, edikasyon sivik ak fòmasyon pwofesyonèl.
text.en: In September 2026, the AIC Foundation organized youth training in Jacmel. A month later, Juno7 reported Olivier Barrau proposing a youth corps for ages 16–35: a three-year pilot covering community service, sport, civic education and vocational training.

text.ht: Lyen ant de aktivite yo se yon enterè piblik nan fòmasyon jèn. Sous sa yo pa pwouve resous fondasyon an te sèvi pou achte vòt, ni yo pa pwouve pwogram nasyonal la deja egziste. Fòk nou egzamine finansman ak règ yo pou fè youn nan konklizyon sa yo.
text.en: The activities share a public interest in youth training. These sources do not establish that foundation resources bought votes or that a national programme already exists. Those conclusions would require examination of funding and rules.

text.ht: Gen yon chanjman enpòtan lè lide a pase soti nan yon fondasyon rive nan leta. Yon sèvis piblik dwe gen kritè moun ka konteste, yon bidjè yo ka suiv ak aksè ki pa depann de patisipasyon nan yon pati. Kapasite pou òganize yon aktivite pa poukont li reponn kesyon sa yo.
text.en: An important change occurs when an idea moves from a foundation to the state. A public service needs contestable selection rules, traceable funding and access independent of party participation. Being able to organize an event does not itself answer those questions.

text.ht: Pou yon jèn k ap chèche travay, fòk pwogram nan di si gen salè, konbyen tan fòmasyon an dire ak kiyès ki rekonèt konpetans li aprann yo. Pou yon patisipan 16 an, règ pwoteksyon ak relasyon ak lekòl li enpòtan tou.
text.en: For a young jobseeker, the programme should explain pay, training length and recognition of acquired skills. For a 16-year-old participant, protection rules and the relationship with schooling also matter.

text.ht: Pi bon mezi a pa kantite moun ki vin nan lansman an. Se sa patisipan yo kapab fè apre: yon konpetans, yon revni oswa yon sèvis kominotè ki dire. Se la pwomès la bezwen yon kalandriye ak yon kont piblik.
text.en: Attendance at a launch is not the strongest measure. What participants can do afterwards matters: a skill, income or lasting community service. That is where the promise needs a timetable and public accounts.

title.ht: Jacky Lumarque: tès fòmasyon pwofesyonèl la kòmanse anvan kanpay la
title.en: Jacky Lumarque: the vocational-training test starts before the campaign

description.ht: Pakou nan edikasyon bay eksperyans pou egzamine, pa yon rezilta pou sipoze.
description.en: An education career supplies experience to examine, not results to assume.

text.ht: Anvan li te rektè, Jacky Lumarque te travay nan fòmasyon pwofesyonèl leta. Biyografi Inivèsite Quisqueya a date nominasyon li kòm direktè jeneral adjwen INFP an 1984 epi direktè jeneral an 1987. Li se rektè inivèsite a depi 2007, dapre menm sous la.
text.en: Before becoming rector, Jacky Lumarque worked in state vocational training. Université Quisqueya’s biography dates his INFP deputy-director appointment to 1984 and director-general appointment to 1987. It says he has been the university’s rector since 2007.

text.ht: Sa fè yon kesyon travay jèn vin yon kesyon sou dosye li tou. Li pa sèlman bezwen di sa li ta fè; li ka montre sa enstitisyon li te dirije yo te fè. Biyografi a soti nan enstitisyon li dirije a, pa nan yon evalyasyon endepandan sou pèfòmans li.
text.en: That makes youth employment a question about his record as well. Beyond saying what he would do, he can show what institutions he led delivered. The biography comes from his own institution, not an independent performance evaluation.

text.ht: Yon sant fòmasyon ka bay anpil diplòm san tout moun jwenn travay. Pou egzamine rezilta a, fòk nou konnen konbyen moun ki antre, konbyen ki fini, pri pou chak patisipan ak kantite ki jwenn travay nan domèn yo apre sa. Menm kesyon sa yo dwe poze pou tout kandida ki pwomèt fòmasyon.
text.en: A training centre can issue many certificates without everyone finding employment. Assessment requires entrants, completions, cost per participant and subsequent work in the trained field. The same questions should apply to every candidate promising training.

text.ht: Gen yon lòt chwa pou esplike: kiyès ki peye? Fanmi, antrepriz ak leta pa gen menm mwayen ni menm enterè. Si yon pwogram depann de frè etidyan yo, fòk kandida a montre kijan jèn ki pi pòv yo ka antre ladan l.
text.en: Another choice needs explanation: who pays? Families, employers and the state have different resources and interests. If a programme depends on student fees, the candidate should show how poorer young people gain access.

text.ht: Se pa yon diplòm kandida a ki pral peye salè yon jèn. Se yon sistèm ki mare sa li aprann ak yon travay ki egziste. Pou Lumarque, ansyen responsablite yo bay piblik la yon kote presi pou kòmanse verifye sistèm sa a.
text.en: A candidate’s diploma will not pay a young person’s wage. A system connecting learning to available work may. Lumarque’s previous responsibilities give the public a specific starting point for examining that connection.

title.ht: Jacky Lumarque an 2015: pa melanje de dosye dechaj yo
title.en: Jacky Lumarque in 2015: do not merge two clearance files

description.ht: Non yon kandida sou yon desizyon pa vle di desizyon an kouvri tout fonksyon li te genyen.
description.en: A candidate’s name on a decision does not mean it covers every previous role.

text.ht: Yon kopi desizyon CSCCA ki gen dat 8 Jen 2015 konsène Jacky Lumarque ak komite nasyonal Wout Esklav la, pou Me 1998 rive Out 2000. Lakou a deklare li pa t kontab lajan piblik pou fonksyon sa a epi li leve restriksyon ki ta sou byen li.
text.en: An archived CSCCA decision dated June 8, 2015 concerns Jacky Lumarque and the national Route de l’Esclave committee for May 1998–August 2000. It declares he was not a public accountant in that role and lifts potential restrictions on his assets.

text.ht: Nan deba sou eksklizyon elektoral li a, gen yon lòt dosye: GTEF, gwoup travay sou edikasyon ak fòmasyon. An Jiyè 2015, Pierre-Louis Opont te defann pozisyon KEP la lè li te di yon sètifika 3 Jen te vini apre delè depo pyès la. Se pozisyon Métropole te rapòte a.
text.en: The electoral-exclusion dispute involved another file: GTEF, the education and training working group. In July 2015, Pierre-Louis Opont defended the CEP’s position by saying a June 3 certificate came after the document deadline. That is the position reported by Métropole.

text.ht: Dat yo ak fonksyon yo pa menm. Donk, sèvi ak desizyon sou Wout Esklav la kòm si se li ki tranche tout kesyon GTEF la ta twonpe lektè a. Menm jan an tou, yon eksklizyon pou dosye elektoral pa yon kondanasyon pou vòl lajan.
text.en: The dates and roles differ. Using the Route de l’Esclave decision as if it settled every GTEF question would mislead readers. Equally, exclusion over electoral paperwork is not a conviction for stealing money.

text.ht: Pou rekonstwi konfli a nèt, fòk chak pyès gen dat depo li, fonksyon li kouvri ak desizyon ki te vini apre l. Sa pèmèt nou poze de kesyon apa: èske kont yo te mande yon dechaj, epi èske enstitisyon elektoral la te aplike pwosedi a kòrèkteman?
text.en: A full reconstruction needs each document’s submission date, covered role and subsequent decision. That separates two questions: did the accounts require clearance, and did the electoral institution correctly apply procedure?

text.ht: Se yon leson pou eleksyon k ap vini an tou. Yon sètifika pa dwe tounen yon benediksyon sou tout lavi yon moun; yon diskisyon sou delè pa dwe tounen yon akizasyon kriminèl. Non dosye a ak sa desizyon an di se premye bagay pou li.
text.en: The lesson applies to the coming election too. A certificate should not become approval of someone’s entire life; a deadline dispute should not become a criminal accusation. Start with the file’s identity and the decision’s actual terms.

title.ht: Marc Arthur Drouillard: sa nòt 2016 la montre dèyè ti kantite vòt la
title.en: Marc Arthur Drouillard: what a 2016 footnote adds to the small vote total

description.ht: Yon rezilta ansyen pa esplike yon alyans. Rapò obsèvatè yo bay yon lòt pyès.
description.en: An old result does not explain an alliance. The observers’ report adds another piece.

text.ht: Nan anèks rezilta pwovizwa rapò Inyon Ewopeyèn sou eleksyon 2016 la, Marc-Arthur Drouillard gen 978 vòt. Men, pi bonè nan menm rapò a, yon nòt di li te retire kò l an favè Jovenel Moïse 27 Septanm 2016.
text.en: In the provisional-results annex of the EU report on the 2016 election, Marc-Arthur Drouillard has 978 votes. Earlier in the same report, a footnote says he withdrew in favour of Jovenel Moïse on September 27, 2016.

text.ht: De enfòmasyon yo ka egziste ansanm. Yon anons retrè pa otomatikman fè yon non disparèt nan tout materyèl elektoral oswa anpeche moun vote pou li. Nou pa sèvi ak total pwovizwa sa a kòm yon mezi sipò Drouillard genyen an 2026.
text.en: Both facts can coexist. An announced withdrawal does not automatically remove a name from every electoral material or prevent votes for it. We do not use that provisional total as a measure of Drouillard’s support in 2026.

text.ht: Sa ki itil pou egzamine se chwa politik la: poukisa li te soutni Moïse nan moman sa a, ki objektif li te anonse, epi ki evalyasyon li fè sou chwa a kounye a? Yon ansyen alyans merite yon eksplikasyon; li pa pwouve yon alyans aktyèl.
text.en: The useful issue is the political choice: why did he support Moïse then, what aims did he state, and how does he assess that decision now? A past alliance merits explanation; it does not establish a present alliance.

text.ht: Gen yon lòt limit enpòtan. Sipòte yon kandida nan yon eleksyon pa pwouve patisipasyon nan zak lòt moun te fè apre sa. Fòk chak akizasyon sou yon zak gen pwòp prèv li. Yon relasyon politik gen yon dat ak yon sans presi.
text.en: Another limit matters. Supporting a candidate in an election does not establish participation in others’ later conduct. Each allegation about an act requires its own evidence. A political relationship has a date and a specific meaning.

text.ht: Lè nou rakonte yon pakou, kesyon an pa sèlman « konbyen vòt li te fè? ». Li se tou « ki moun li te ede pran pouvwa, pou ki rezon, epi ki sa li aprann? ». Ti nòt sa a fè dosye a vin pi rich pase yon klasman.
text.en: When tracing a career, the question extends beyond “how many votes?” to “whom did he help into power, why, and what did he learn?” The footnote makes the record more informative than a ranking alone.

title.ht: Kely Bastien: kiyès ki chwazi l pou DELIVRANS?
title.en: Kely Bastien: who selected him for DELIVRANS?

description.ht: Chwa yon kowalisyon esplike ki jan pouvwa òganize anndan l; li pa mezire vòt peyi a.
description.en: A coalition’s selection explains its internal organization, not the country’s voting intentions.

text.ht: Kely C. Bastien pa t poukont li nan pwosesis DELIVRANS lan. Dapre kominike FCN rapòte a, ANSANM te pwopoze non li; LÒD DEMOKRATIK te pwopoze Djina Guillet Delatour. Konferans prezidan platfòm nan te chwazi Bastien pa majorite 13 Novanm 2026.
text.en: Kely C. Bastien was not the only proposed DELIVRANS nominee. According to the communiqué reported by FCN, ANSANM proposed him and LÒD DEMOKRATIK proposed Djina Guillet Delatour. The platform’s presidents’ conference selected Bastien by majority on November 13, 2026.

text.ht: Delatour te felisite l epi rekonèt chwa a. Nan deklarasyon FCN rapòte a, li te kenbe rezèv li sou pwosesis elektoral la. Sa montre yon moun ka aksepte yon desizyon entèn san li abandone tout pozisyon pa l.
text.en: Delatour congratulated him and acknowledged the choice. In the statement reported by FCN, she retained reservations about the electoral process. Someone can accept an internal decision without abandoning every position of her own.

text.ht: Pou lektè a, gen twa nivo apa: pati manm yo pwopoze, dirijan kowalisyon an chwazi, epi elektè yo vote. Yon majorite nan dezyèm nivo a pa otomatikman yon majorite nan twazyèm nan. Fòk sipò piblik la mezire apa.
text.en: For readers, three levels remain distinct: member parties propose, coalition leaders select, and citizens vote. A majority at the second level is not automatically a majority at the third. Public support requires separate measurement.

text.ht: Kesyon ki vini apre a se sou sa ki mare gwoup yo: ki pwogram yo aksepte ansanm, kijan yo pran desizyon sou lajan ak nominasyon, epi ki règ ki rete si yo pa dakò? Yon kowalisyon dwe kapab esplike pwòp règ li anvan li mande pou dirije peyi a.
text.en: The next issue is what binds the groups: their common programme, how they decide on money and appointments, and what happens when they disagree. A coalition should explain its own rules before seeking to govern the country’s.

text.ht: Sa se yon kesyon òganizasyon politik, pa yon akizasyon sou antant sekrè. Non chak estrikti ak etap desizyon an bay yon bon kote pou kòmanse egzamine relasyon sa yo.
text.en: This concerns political organization, not an allegation of a secret deal. Naming each organization and decision stage provides a concrete starting point for examining those relationships.

title.ht: Kely Bastien: tès transparans lan pa kòmanse ak kanpay sa a
title.en: Kely Bastien: the transparency test predates this campaign

description.ht: Yon ansyen fich ofisyèl montre ki dosye piblik pou egzamine dèyè nouvo kandidati a.
description.en: An old official briefing points to the public record behind the new candidacy.

text.ht: Non Kely Bastien nan dokiman piblik entènasyonal yo parèt lontan anvan chwa DELIVRANS lan. Yon fich ki nan rapò vwayaj 2011 sou sit komite afè etranjè Sena ameriken an dekri l kòm senatè Nò epi pale sou eleksyon li kòm prezidan Sena an 2008.
text.en: Kely Bastien appears in international public records long before DELIVRANS selected him. A briefing in a 2011 trip report hosted by the U.S. Senate Foreign Relations Committee identifies the northern senator and records his election as Senate president in 2008.

text.ht: Fich la prezante transparans nan Sena ak pi bon relasyon ant pouvwa yo kòm objektif li. Li pa yon odit ki deklare objektif sa yo te reyalize. Li pa prèv tout rankont ki te sou ajanda vizit la te fèt nonplis.
text.en: The briefing describes Senate transparency and better relations between branches as his objectives. It is not an audit establishing those objectives were achieved. Nor does it prove every meeting on the visit’s agenda occurred.

text.ht: Se la eksperyans yon ansyen dirijan vin yon dosye piblik pou egzamine. Si yon moun te gen responsablite nan yon asanble, piblik la ka chèche bidjè asanble a, rapò sou depans ak tras desizyon yo. Yon tit montre kote pou fouye; li pa bay rezilta fouy la davans.
text.en: That is where a former leader’s experience becomes a record for public examination. Assembly responsibilities point readers towards budgets, expenditure reports and decision records. A title identifies where to investigate; it does not predetermine the findings.

text.ht: Pou yon fanmi ki peye taks, transparans vle di yon bagay konkrè: li ka wè kote lajan ale epi konpare sa ak sèvis li resevwa. Se menm tès la pou kandida ki soti nan Sena, nan yon ministè oswa nan yon antrepriz.
text.en: For a taxpaying household, transparency means something concrete: seeing where money goes and comparing it with services received. The same test applies to candidates coming from the Senate, a ministry or a company.

text.ht: Chwa DELIVRANS te fè an Novanm 2026 la se yon nouvo etap politik. Li pa fè ansyen responsablite yo disparèt, ni li pa prèv yon fot. Li fè dokiman sou responsablite sa yo vin enpòtan pou lektè a ankò.
text.en: DELIVRANS’s November 2026 selection is a new political step. It neither erases earlier responsibilities nor proves wrongdoing. It makes the documents about those responsibilities relevant to readers again.

title.ht: Lucmanne Delille ak G9: de dat ki bezwen mache ak istwa a
title.en: Lucmanne Delille and G9: two dates his account must address

description.ht: Yon rapò ONU ak yon repons li te bay an 2022 pa mete fòmasyon G9 nan menm moman.
description.en: A UN report and a published account of his 2022 response place G9’s formation differently.

text.ht: 10 Jen 2020: se dat rapò sekretè jeneral ONU a bay pou fòmasyon alyans G9 an fanmi an. 9 Jiyè 2020: se dat menm rapò a bay pou Rockefeller Vincent ranplase Lucmanne Délille nan ministè Jistis la. Gen 29 jou ant de dat sa yo.
text.en: June 10, 2020: the UN Secretary-General’s report dates the formation of the G9 an fanmi alliance. July 9, 2020: the same report dates Rockefeller Vincent’s replacement of Lucmanne Délille as justice minister. Those dates are 29 days apart.

text.ht: Men nan rapò Gazette Haïti sou repons Delille te bay Joseph Jouthe 4 Avril 2022 a, Delille di G9 pa t fòme pandan li te minis, men apre depa li. Jounal la rapòte tou li te rejte akizasyon ansyen premye minis la epi prezante pwòp vèsyon revokasyon li.
text.en: Yet in Gazette Haïti’s account of Delille’s April 4, 2022 response to Joseph Jouthe, Delille says G9 formed after his departure, rather than during his ministry. The outlet also reports his rejection of the former prime minister’s allegations and his own account of dismissal.

text.ht: Diferans lan presi: dapre kwonoloji ONU a, alyans lan te deja egziste lè li te kite ministè a. Sa mande yon eksplikasyon sou sa li te rele « fòmasyon » nan entèvansyon 2022 a, oswa sou fason pawòl yo te rapòte. Nou li atik la; nou pa t gade tout videyo emisyon an.
text.en: The discrepancy is specific: in the UN chronology, the alliance existed before he left office. That calls for clarification of what “formation” meant in the 2022 appearance, or how the statement was reported. We reviewed the article, not the entire broadcast video.

text.ht: Sa pa pwouve Delille te kreye, finanse oswa soutni G9. Sa pa tranche rezon revokasyon an nonplis. Dat yon gwoup parèt, sa yon minis te konnen ak aksyon li te pran se twa kesyon ki mande prèv diferan.
text.en: This does not establish that Delille created, financed or supported G9. Nor does it settle why he was dismissed. A group’s emergence, a minister’s knowledge and the actions he took require different evidence.

text.ht: Pou egzamine dosye sekirite yon kandida, kòmanse ak yon liy tan moun ka verifye. Apre sa, chèche lòd, rapò operasyon ak desizyon ki montre sa otorite yo te fè. Yon istwa politik ki rakonte apre evènman an dwe kapab kanpe bò kote dat ki te ekri nan epòk la.
text.en: To examine a candidate’s security record, start with a checkable timeline. Then seek orders, operational reports and decisions showing what authorities did. A political account told afterwards must withstand comparison with dates recorded at the time.

title.ht: Dominique Dupuy ak rapèl diplomat yo: ki ekonomi ki te fèt?
title.en: Dominique Dupuy’s diplomatic recalls: what savings followed?

description.ht: Fè yon administrasyon pi piti ak fè l sèvi pi byen se de rezilta pou mezire apa.
