description.en: Making an administration smaller and making it work better are separate outcomes.

text.ht: An Jiyè 2024, Dominique Dupuy te defann rapèl diplomat kòm yon refòm pou adapte depans diplomasi a ak mwayen peyi a. Métropole te rapòte plis pase 80 diplomat ak lòt anplwaye reprezantasyon ta konsène. Minis la pa t bay lis la pandan entèvansyon sa a.
text.en: In July 2024, Dominique Dupuy defended diplomatic recalls as reform to align diplomatic costs with the country’s means. Métropole reported more than 80 diplomats and representation staff were reportedly affected. The minister did not release the list during that appearance.

text.ht: Li te mete konpetans ak wotasyon an devan, epi li te rejte lide refòm nan te fèt pou rezon politik oswa klan. Se eksplikasyon pa l. Atik la pa bay yon odit sou ekonomi, sou moun ki te ranplase lòt yo oswa sou sèvis konsilè apre sa.
text.en: She emphasized competence and rotation, rejecting political or factional motives. That is her explanation. The article does not provide an audit of savings, replacements or subsequent consular service.

text.ht: Pou yon Ayisyen k ap tann yon dokiman aletranje, kesyon an pa fini nan kantite moun yo raple. Konbyen tan sèvis la pran? Konbyen li koute? Èske anplwaye ki rete yo gen kapasite pou bay li? Yon depans ki bese pandan yon sèvis vin pi difisil pa rakonte menm istwa ak yon sèvis ki amelyore.
text.en: For a Haitian awaiting a document abroad, the issue extends beyond the recall count. How long does service take? What does it cost? Can remaining staff deliver it? Lower spending alongside harder access tells a different story from improved service.

text.ht: Yon konparezon itil ta mete depans anvan ak apre, kantite pòs vid oswa ranpli, epi delè prensipal sèvis yo sou menm peryòd. Fòk li konte depans tranzisyon tou. Se konsa piblik la ka wè yon ekonomi reyèl olye yon senp deplasman depans.
text.en: A useful comparison would align before-and-after expenditure, vacant and filled positions, and major service delays over comparable periods. It should include transition costs. That would distinguish real savings from costs merely shifted elsewhere.

text.ht: Dosye a merite egzamen paske li konsène yon desizyon li te defann pandan li te gen pouvwa. Ni yon refòm ki anonse ni kritik sou motif li pa ranplase mezi rezilta a.
text.en: The record merits examination because it concerns a decision she defended while in office. Neither an announced reform nor criticism of its motives substitutes for measuring results.

title.ht: Dominique Dupuy: menas 2024 yo ak de fanm nan lis prezidansyèl la
title.en: Dominique Dupuy: the 2024 threats and two women on the presidential list

description.ht: Yon lis enskripsyon montre kiyès ki rive nan pòt la; li pa esplike tout baryè sou wout la.
description.en: A registration list shows who reaches the door, not every barrier encountered.

text.ht: 24 Mas 2024, Dominique Dupuy te anonse li retire kò l nan pwosesis fòmasyon konsèy prezidansyèl la. Nan deklarasyon videyo HaitiLibre rapòte a, li te denonse atak politik ak menas sou lavi li. Li te reprezante regroupman RED/EDE ak alye li yo nan pwosesis sa a.
text.en: On March 24, 2024, Dominique Dupuy announced withdrawal from the presidential-council formation process. In the video statement reported by HaitiLibre, she described political attacks and threats to her life. She had been the RED/EDE grouping and allies’ designated representative.

text.ht: Se pa yon desizyon tribinal ki idantifye moun ki te fè menas yo. Nou pa bay yon pati oswa yon moun responsablite kriminèl atik la pa etabli. Men yon deklarasyon retrè konsa se yon eleman piblik enpòtan nan pakou politik li.
text.en: This is not a judgment identifying those responsible for threats. We do not assign criminal responsibility the article does not establish. Such a withdrawal statement nevertheless forms an important public part of her political record.

text.ht: Nan tablo KEP nou verifye 15 Novanm 2026 la, gen 2 fanm sou 32 enskripsyon prezidansyèl: 6,25%, dapre kalkil nou. Sa se yon foto enskripsyon preliminè yo, pa yon lis final, yon sondaj oswa yon mezi kapasite kandida yo.
text.en: The CEP dashboard checked November 15, 2026 shows 2 women among 32 presidential registrations: 6.25%, by our calculation. This is a snapshot of preliminary registrations, not a final list, poll or measure of candidates’ abilities.

text.ht: Chif sa a poukont li pa pwouve poukisa lòt fanm pa enskri. Pou konprann baryè yo, fòk nou egzamine fason pati chwazi kandida, aksè ak finansman, kondisyon sekirite ak eksperyans moun ki te eseye antre nan kous la. Pa fè yon sèl istwa esplike tout sistèm nan.
text.en: That figure alone cannot explain why other women did not register. Understanding barriers requires examining party selection, access to finance, security conditions and experiences of people who tried to run. One person’s story cannot explain the entire system.

text.ht: Epi menm egzijans sou dosye ak pwogram dwe aplike pou tout moun. Pran menas politik oserye ak egzamine yon kandida sevè se de travay ki ka fèt ansanm.
text.en: The same scrutiny of record and programme should apply to everyone. Taking political threats seriously and examining a candidate rigorously are compatible tasks.

title.ht: Déus Deronneth nan Marigo: poukisa premye rezilta a pa t dènye mo a
title.en: Déus Deronneth in Marigot: why the first result was not the last word

description.ht: Yon ansyen kous palmantè montre sa yon kontestasyon ka chanje, ak sa li pa pwouve.
description.en: An old parliamentary contest shows what a challenge can change, and what it cannot establish.

text.ht: Dapre rapò misyon Inyon Ewopeyèn sou eleksyon 2016 la, egzamen 34 kontestasyon pou pòs senatè ak depite te ranvèse yon sèl rezilta depite: Marigo. Se yon konklizyon obsèvatè yo sou pwosesis la.
text.en: According to the EU mission’s 2016 election report, examination of 34 legislative challenges reversed just one deputy result: Marigot. This is the observers’ account of the process.

text.ht: Rezo Nòdwès te rapòte an Janvye 2017 desizyon final la te bay Déus Deronneth, kandida PONT, viktwa sou Dieudonné Lhérisson, ki te pi byen plase nan rezilta preliminè yo. Rapò sou vyolans ki te swiv yo pa etabli Deronneth te bay lòd pou okenn zak.
text.en: Rezo Nòdwès reported in January 2017 that the final decision gave PONT candidate Déus Deronneth victory over Dieudonné Lhérisson, who had ranked ahead in preliminary results. Reports of subsequent violence do not establish that Deronneth ordered any act.

text.ht: Pou konprann yon rezilta konsa, fòk nou li desizyon elektoral la ak chanjman nan pwosè-vèbal yo. Yon jounal ki bay non gayan an pa otomatikman esplike ki vòt yo te konte, retire oswa korije. Nou pa prezante atik la kòm yon kopi jijman an.
text.en: Understanding such a result requires the electoral decision and changes to polling records. An outlet naming the winner does not automatically explain which votes were counted, excluded or corrected. We do not present that article as the judgment itself.

text.ht: Sa itil pou moun k ap suiv kous aktyèl la. Premye chif yo ka gen kontestasyon; kontestasyon yo bezwen yon delè, yon baz ak yon desizyon moun ka jwenn. Yon moun ki ranpòte yon rekou pa otomatikman fè fwod, menm jan yon moun ki plenyen pa otomatikman gen rezon.
text.en: This matters for people following the present race. Initial totals may face challenges, which need deadlines, grounds and accessible decisions. Winning a challenge does not automatically imply fraud; filing one does not automatically establish merit.

text.ht: Nan pakou Deronneth, dosye Marigo a montre yon etap presi nan aksè li nan pouvwa. Li mande lekti pyès ki te chanje rezilta a, pa yon lejand sou fason eleksyon toujou mache.
text.en: In Deronneth’s career, Marigot identifies a specific step into office. It calls for the records that changed the result, rather than a legend about how elections always work.

title.ht: Joanas Gué te mande acha lokal an 2010. Kantin yo bay yon tès jodi a.
title.en: Joanas Gué called for local buying in 2010. School meals offer a test today.

description.ht: Yon lide ka retounen nan plizyè kanpay. Fòk nou egzamine sistèm ki fè l tounen acha reyèl.
description.en: An idea can recur across campaigns. The purchasing system determines delivery.

text.ht: Apre tranblemanntè 2010 la, minis agrikilti Joanas Gué te defann yon chanjman nan èd alimantè: achte nan men pwodiktè ayisyen olye tout apwovizyònman an soti nan enpòtasyon. Se pozisyon Métropole te rapòte 15 Mas 2010 la.
text.en: After the 2010 earthquake, agriculture minister Joanas Gué advocated redirecting food assistance towards purchases from Haitian producers rather than relying on imports. Métropole reported that position on March 15, 2010.

text.ht: An Jen 2026, responsab PAM te rapòte pwogram kantin òganizasyon an te pase soti nan 450 000 rive nan 650 000 timoun sou de ane. Prèske twa ka manje sa yo te pwodui lokalman, kont mwatye de ane anvan. Sa yo se chif PAM pou pwòp pwogram li, pa pou tout kantin peyi a.
text.en: In June 2026, a WFP official reported its school-meal programme had grown from 450,000 to 650,000 children over two years. Nearly three-quarters of those meals were locally produced, up from half. These are WFP’s figures for its programme, not every canteen in Haiti.

text.ht: De sous yo pa pwouve apèl Gué an 2010 la te lakòz rezilta 2026 yo. Yo montre pito yon kesyon ki dire: kijan depans pou manje ka fè timoun manje epi bay pwodiktè yon mache? Pwogram Etzer Emile a reprann acha lokal pou kantin tou.
text.en: The sources do not establish that Gué’s 2010 appeal caused the 2026 results. They reveal an enduring question: how can food spending feed children while giving producers a market? Etzer Emile’s programme also proposes local purchasing for school meals.

text.ht: Pou yon kiltivatè, kliyan an dwe bay yon kantite, yon pri ak yon dat peman. Pou yon lekòl, manje dwe rive alè epi an bon kondisyon. Se kontra, depo, transpò ak peman regilye ki mare de bezwen sa yo ansanm.
text.en: A farmer needs an agreed quantity, price and payment date. A school needs timely, safe food. Contracts, storage, transport and reliable payment connect those needs.

text.ht: Se la konparezon kandida yo dwe antre pi fon pase slogan « pwodiksyon nasyonal ». Kiyès ki achte, nan ki men, sou ki règ ak ak ki kontwòl? San repons sa yo, menm bèl lide a ka retounen nan chak eleksyon san li elaji sèvis la.
text.en: Candidate comparisons should therefore go deeper than “national production.” Who buys, from whom, under what rules and oversight? Without those answers, an attractive idea can recur at each election without expanding service.

title.ht: Joanas Gué ak 115 sistèm irigasyon yo: reparasyon bezwen yon swit
title.en: Joanas Gué and 115 irrigation systems: repairs need a follow-through

description.ht: Yon ansyen deklarasyon sou travay agrikòl louvri yon dosye sou antretyen ak rezilta.
description.en: An old statement on agricultural works opens a record of maintenance and outcomes.

text.ht: Nan entèvyou Métropole te rapòte 7 Janvye 2009 la, Joanas Gué te di yon pati nan lajan ijans te sèvi pou repare 115 sistèm irigasyon apre pasaj siklòn 2008 yo. Li te minis agrikilti lè li te fè deklarasyon sa a. Se kont pa l, pa yon odit nou fè sou chak sistèm.
text.en: In an interview reported by Métropole on January 7, 2009, Joanas Gué said emergency funds had been used to repair 115 irrigation systems after the 2008 hurricanes. He was agriculture minister. This is his account, not our audit of each system.

text.ht: Poukisa retounen sou yon ansyen chif? Paske yon sistèm irigasyon pa sèvi yon kiltivatè sèlman jou yo fini travay la. Li bezwen dlo, kanal ki pa bouche ak moun ki responsab antretyen. San swit sa a, yon reparasyon ka pa pwoteje pwochen rekòt la.
text.en: Why revisit an old number? An irrigation system serves farmers beyond the day work ends. It needs water, clear canals and assigned maintenance. Without follow-through, a repair may fail to protect the next harvest.

text.ht: Pou egzamine travay la, premye lis itil la se non ak kote 115 sistèm yo, travay ki te prevwa, montan ki te peye ak dat resepsyon. Dezyèm lis la ta montre kiyès ki te pran antretyen an ak kijan itilizatè yo te patisipe. Yon total nasyonal pa ranplase detay sa yo.
text.en: Assessing the work starts with names and locations of the 115 systems, planned works, payments and acceptance dates. A second record would identify maintenance responsibility and user participation. A national total cannot replace those details.

text.ht: Fòk evalyasyon an konsidere tou sa ki te rive apre: nouvo dezas, chanjman administrasyon ak resous ki te disponib. Yon sistèm ki pa mache jodi a pa poukont li pwouve travay 2009 la pa t fèt oswa yon moun te vòlè lajan.
text.en: Assessment must also consider later disasters, changes of administration and available resources. A system failing today does not by itself establish that work in 2009 never occurred or money was stolen.

text.ht: Men ansyen responsablite a rete enpòtan. Yon kandida ki pwomèt rebati agrikilti ka montre sa eksperyans li aprann li sou antretyen, pa sèlman sou lansman chantye. Se diferans ant yon travay ki anonse ak yon sèvis kiltivatè a ka konte sou li.
text.en: The earlier responsibility still matters. A candidate promising agricultural recovery can show what experience taught about maintenance, beyond launching projects. That separates an announced work from a service farmers can rely on.

title.ht: Jerry Tardieu: soti nan yon pwopozisyon lwa sou PNH rive nan pwomès gad nasyonal la
title.en: Jerry Tardieu: from a PNH bill to a national-guard proposal

description.ht: Dosye palmantè a ak nouvo pwomès sekirite a bezwen li etap pa etap.
description.en: The legislative record and new security proposal need to be read stage by stage.

text.ht: An Me 2016, Rezo Nòdwès te rapòte depite Jerry Tardieu depoze yon pwopozisyon lwa 98 atik pou reòganize PNH. Tèks rapò a te dekri nouvo direksyon pou polis teritoryal, fwontyè, fòmasyon ak administrasyon prizon, pami lòt fonksyon.
text.en: In May 2016, Rezo Nòdwès reported deputy Jerry Tardieu submitting a 98-article bill to reorganize the PNH. Its account described new directorates for territorial policing, borders, training and prison administration, among other functions.

text.ht: Sou sit kanpay li an 2026, Tardieu pwopoze ranfòse PNH ak lame epi kreye yon gad nasyonal jèn pou repran teritwa gwoup ame yo kontwole. Se yon pwopozisyon kanpay, pa yon fòs nou verifye ki deja etabli.
text.en: On his 2026 campaign site, Tardieu proposes strengthening police and army and creating a youth national guard to recover territory controlled by armed groups. This is a campaign proposal, not a force we have verified as established.

text.ht: Premye kesyon an se sou chenn otorite a. Kiyès ki rekrite, fòme, peye ak bay lòd? Lè yon moun pote zam ak pouvwa piblik, règ sou responsablite li enpòtan menm jan ak ekipman li genyen. Fòk plan an esplike relasyon nouvo fòs la ak enstitisyon ki deja la yo.
text.en: The first issue is command. Who recruits, trains, pays and gives orders? When someone carries weapons and public authority, accountability rules matter alongside equipment. The plan needs to explain how a new force relates to existing institutions.

text.ht: Dezyèm kesyon an se sa ki te rive ansyen pwopozisyon an. Depoze yon pwopozisyon lwa, fè l adopte, pibliye l epi egzekite l se etap diferan. Atik 2016 la etabli depo a; li pa sifi pou bay tout etap ki vini apre yo kòm rezilta.
text.en: The second issue is what followed the earlier bill. Submission, passage, promulgation and implementation are different stages. The 2016 article establishes submission; it cannot stand in for every later outcome.

text.ht: Pou piblik la, yon nouvo non enstitisyon pa garanti yon nouvo kalite pwoteksyon. Se règleman, kontwòl ak kapasite pou kenbe sèvis la ki pral montre sa chanjman an pote.
text.en: For the public, a new institution’s name does not guarantee a different quality of protection. Rules, oversight and the ability to sustain service will show what changes.

title.ht: Jerry Tardieu ak dyaspora a: vote, gen reprezantan ak okipe yon pòs piblik pa menm dwa
title.en: Jerry Tardieu and the diaspora: voting, representation and office differ

description.ht: Yon ansyen pwopozisyon ede separe kesyon yo sou patisipasyon Ayisyen aletranje.
description.en: An earlier proposal helps separate questions about participation from abroad.

text.ht: Nan yon rankont an Florid an 2016, Jerry Tardieu te defann reprezantasyon dyaspora a nan Palman ayisyen an. Rezo Nòdwès te rapòte li te vle mete lide a nan yon pwopozisyon amannman Konstitisyon an. Se yon pwojè politik li te prezante, pa prèv yon dwa te antre an aplikasyon.
text.en: At a 2016 gathering in Florida, Jerry Tardieu advocated diaspora representation in Haiti’s Parliament. Rezo Nòdwès reported that he wanted the idea included in a constitutional-amendment proposal. This documents a political project, not proof an operative right was created.

text.ht: Sou sit kanpay li a, dosye dwa dyaspora a toujou parèt nan lis travay palmantè li mete devan piblik la. Sa pèmèt lektè yo suiv yon tèm sou tan, men li mande yo egzamine dokiman legal ki te swiv deklarasyon yo.
text.en: His campaign site still includes diaspora rights among the legislative work he presents. That lets readers trace a theme over time, while requiring examination of the legal documents that followed the statements.

text.ht: Gen omwen twa kesyon apa: èske yon moun ka vote kote li rete a, èske li ka eli yon reprezantan pou kominote aletranje a, epi èske li ka kandida pou yon pòs nan peyi a? Yon chanjman sou youn pa otomatikman bay de lòt yo.
text.en: At least three questions differ: can a person vote where they live, elect a representative for an overseas community, and run for an office in Haiti? A change to one does not automatically resolve the others.

text.ht: Pou chak pwomès, fòk nou jwenn tèks la, dat li antre an vigè ak enstitisyon ki dwe aplike l. Lè sa depann de yon chanjman nan Konstitisyon, kandida a dwe esplike chemen legal la. Yon deklarasyon kanpay pa ranplase etap sa yo.
text.en: For each promise, readers need the text, effective date and implementing institution. When constitutional change is required, the candidate should explain the legal route. A campaign statement cannot replace those steps.

text.ht: Sa pa bay yon repons legal sou sitiyasyon pèsonèl yon elektè. Li bay yon fason pou pa kite mo « entegrasyon » an melanje plizyè dwa diferan. Pou demach aktyèl yo, se dènye enstriksyon KEP yo ak tèks ki an vigè yo ki dwe gide moun.
text.en: This does not decide an individual voter’s legal position. It helps prevent the word “integration” from merging distinct rights. Current procedures require the latest CEP instructions and operative legal texts.

title.ht: Jerry Tardieu ak Konstitisyon an: kiyès konsiltasyon 2017 yo te rive jwenn?
title.en: Jerry Tardieu and the Constitution: whom did the 2017 consultations reach?

description.ht: Yon kominike bay tras rankont yo, men li pa ranplase kontribisyon ak desizyon yo.
description.en: A communiqué records meetings, but cannot replace submissions and decisions.

text.ht: Nan yon kominike 30 Oktòb 2017, komisyon espesyal amannman Konstitisyon Chanm depite a te dekri konsiltasyon li yo. Tèks Juno7 pibliye a idantifye Jerry Tardieu kòm prezidan komisyon an epi site sektè tankou antrepriz, medya, jistis, inivèsite ak enstitisyon kontwòl.
text.en: In an October 30, 2017 communiqué, the Chamber of Deputies’ constitutional-amendment commission described its consultations. The text published by Juno7 identifies Jerry Tardieu as chair and lists business, media, justice, universities and oversight institutions among participating sectors.

text.ht: Kominike a te anonse tou lòt etap, tankou atelye nan dis depatman yo ak nan dyaspora a. Fòk nou distenge sa komisyon an deklare li te fè ak sa li te prevwa fè. Yon ajanda se pa yon rapò sou aktivite ki fin fèt.
text.en: The communiqué also announced further steps, including workshops across the ten departments and diaspora. What the commission reports doing differs from what it planned. An agenda is not a completion report.

text.ht: Yon konsiltasyon vin itil lè piblik la ka suiv chemen yon lide: kiyès ki te pwopoze l, ki rezon yo te bay, epi poukisa yo te kenbe l oswa rejte l. Yon lis òganizasyon ki rankontre pa poukont li montre ki moun ki te enfliyanse tèks final la.
text.en: A consultation becomes useful when the public can trace an idea: who proposed it, the reasons offered, and why it was retained or rejected. A list of participating organizations cannot by itself show who shaped the final text.

text.ht: Fòk lektè a chèche kontribisyon yo, rapò ki fè sentèz yo ak vòt ki te swiv. Sa ta ede wè si enkyetid yon komin oswa yon gwoup sitwayen te antre nan chanjman yo. Absans yon gwoup nan kominike sa a pa prèv li pa t janm patisipe.
text.en: Readers should seek submissions, synthesis reports and subsequent votes. Those would show whether a commune’s or citizen group’s concerns entered the changes. Absence from this communiqué does not prove a group never participated.

text.ht: Pou yon kandida ki mete eksperyans refòm li devan, kesyon an pa sèlman kantite rankont li te fè. Se kijan rankont yo te chanje yon desizyon moun ka li. Se la patisipasyon kite foto ofisyèl pou l vin yon tras piblik.
text.en: For a candidate presenting reform experience, the issue extends beyond meeting totals to how meetings changed a readable decision. That turns participation from an official photograph into a public record.

title.ht: Munir Mourra ak bidjè sekirite yo: « plis 100% » vle di ki sa?
title.en: Munir Mourra’s security budgets: what does “100% more” mean?

description.ht: Double yon montan pa otomatikman double sèvis la. Chif depa ak pri yo enpòtan.
description.en: Doubling an amount does not automatically double service. The starting point and prices matter.

text.ht: Manifès MPH la pwopoze ajoute 100% sou bidjè jistis, lapolis ak lame a. Paj kandida pati a idantifye Munir Joseph Mourra kòm kandida prezidansyèl ki pote angajman manifès sa a. Se yon pwomès sou resous leta, pa yon depans ki deja fèt.
text.en: The MPH manifesto proposes increasing the budgets of justice, police and army by 100%. The party’s candidate page identifies Munir Joseph Mourra as its presidential candidate carrying that manifesto. This is a proposal for state resources, not completed expenditure.

text.ht: Nan matematik, ajoute 100% sou yon montan se double l. Men pou konprann pwomès la, fòk nou konnen ki ane ak ki bidjè ki sèvi kòm baz. Double lajan yo te otorize pa menm kalkil ak double sa yo te depanse toutbon.
text.en: Mathematically, adding 100% doubles an amount. Understanding the promise requires the baseline year and budget. Doubling authorized funds differs from doubling expenditure actually executed.

text.ht: Gen kesyon pri a tou. Si ekipman ak sèvis vin pi chè, yon pi gwo bidjè ka achte mwens pase sa moun imajine. Se menm bagay yon fanmi wè lè salè li monte men manje ak transpò monte tou. Se poutèt sa fòk nou konte sa lajan an ka achte.
text.en: Prices matter too. If equipment and services become more expensive, a larger budget can buy less than people expect. Families recognize the same problem when wages rise alongside food and transport costs. Purchasing power belongs in the assessment.

text.ht: Plan an bezwen separe salè, fòmasyon, operasyon, tribinal, prizon ak envestisman. Li bezwen montre sous lajan an ak fason piblik la ap suiv peman yo. Twa enstitisyon ki jwenn plis lajan pa otomatikman travay pi byen ansanm.
text.en: The plan needs to separate pay, training, operations, courts, prisons and investment, identify funding sources and show how payments will be tracked. Larger budgets for three institutions do not automatically improve coordination.

text.ht: Pou yon moun k ap chèche pwoteksyon, dènye mezi a se sèvis la: yon ekip ki rive, yon ankèt ki fèt ak yon tribinal ki fonksyone. Se sou rezilta sa yo ogmantasyon an dwe rive rann kont.
text.en: For someone seeking protection, the final measure is service: a unit responding, an investigation conducted and a functioning court. The increase should be accountable for those outcomes.

title.ht: Munir Mourra vle yon bank agrikòl. Pwoblèm kredi a gen yon istwa.
title.en: Munir Mourra proposes an agricultural bank. The credit problem has a history.

description.ht: Yon nouvo enstitisyon dwe esplike sa li pral fè diferan nan lavi kiltivatè a.
description.en: A new institution should explain what changes in a farmer’s life.

text.ht: Manifès MPH Munir Joseph Mourra ap pote a pwopoze kreye yon bank agrikòl. Li mete lide a bò kote travay sou kanal irigasyon ak distribisyon pwodui agrikòl. Se yon pwopozisyon pati a nou egzamine, pa yon bank nou verifye ki deja louvri.
text.en: The MPH manifesto carried by Munir Joseph Mourra proposes creating an agricultural bank, alongside irrigation-channel work and agricultural distribution. We are examining a party proposal, not a bank verified as already open.

text.ht: Kesyon kredi agrikòl la pa nouvo nan lavi piblik ayisyen. Nan entèvyou Janvye 2009 li a, Joanas Gué te site Biwo Kredi Agrikòl la epi kritike ti kantite prè li te bay sou dis ane. Sa se evalyasyon Gué nan epòk la, pa yon bilan aktyèl enstitisyon an.
text.en: Agricultural credit is not a new Haitian public-policy issue. In his January 2009 interview, Joanas Gué referred to the Bureau de Crédit Agricole and criticized its limited lending over ten years. That is Gué’s assessment then, not a present-day institutional balance sheet.

text.ht: Sa bay yon konparezon itil: èske bezwen an se yon nouvo non, plis lajan, yon nouvo kalite garanti oswa yon lòt fason pou evalye risk rekòt? Se pa menm repons yo. Fòk kandida a montre ki feblès nouvo bank la ap korije.
text.en: That creates a useful comparison: is the need a new name, more capital, different guarantees or another way to assess harvest risk? These are different answers. The candidate should identify the weakness a new bank would correct.

text.ht: Pou yon kiltivatè, prè a dwe rive anvan sezon plante a epi ranbousman an dwe mache ak rekòt la. Fòk gen règ sou sa ki rive apre yon inondasyon, kiyès ki ka prete ak kijan yo evite kontak politik ranplase yon bon dosye.
text.en: For a farmer, credit needs to arrive before planting and repayment should fit the harvest cycle. Rules must address flooding losses, eligibility and prevention of political connections replacing sound applications.

text.ht: Yon bank ka sèvi pwodiksyon san li vin yon kès favè. Men diferans lan mande kapital, règ ak kontwòl piblik. Se sa ki pral fè yon nouvo enstitisyon diferan de yon nouvo afich sou menm pwoblèm nan.
text.en: A bank can support production without becoming a favours fund. The difference requires capital, rules and public oversight. Those would distinguish a new institution from a new sign over the same problem.

title.ht: Marc Arthur Drouillard ak MORED: sa frè 100 dola a pwomèt
title.en: Marc Arthur Drouillard and MORED: what the $100 fee offers

description.ht: Yon paj manm mete sèvis ak angajman politik ansanm. Fòk kont yo montre sa chak montan peye.
description.en: A membership page combines services and political participation. The accounts need to show what each payment funds.

text.ht: Sou sit MORED ki nonmen Marc-Arthur Drouillard la, yon pwogram « 1 000 Eli MORED » mande 100 dola chak mwa. Avantaj paj la site yo gen ladan konsiltasyon, fòmasyon, rabè sou sèvis Mèt Marc-Arthur ak rityèl pwoteksyon. Se sa sit la ofri; se pa prèv nou verifye moun resevwa sèvis yo.
text.en: On the MORED website naming Marc-Arthur Drouillard, a “1,000 Eli MORED” programme asks for $100 monthly. Advertised benefits include consultation, training, discounted Marc-Arthur services and protection rituals. These are the site’s offers, not services we have independently verified as delivered.

text.ht: Yon egzanp kalkil montre poukisa kont yo itil: si 1 000 manm ta peye 100 dola pou yon mwa, sa ta bay 100 000 dola anvan depans. Se yon egzanp, pa yon resi. Nou pa gen prèv tout kantite manm sa a peye.
text.en: An illustrative calculation shows why accounts matter: if 1,000 members paid $100 for one month, that would produce $100,000 before expenses. This is an example, not a receipt. We do not have evidence that this many people pay.

text.ht: Fòk gen yon lòt distenksyon ankò. Paj sa a sèvi ak etikèt MORED; enskripsyon prezidansyèl Drouillard nan KEP la sèvi ak MRN. Nou pa deklare se menm antite legal oswa menm kès la. Lyen an mande dokiman sou òganizasyon ak finansman yo.
text.en: Another distinction matters. The page uses MORED; Drouillard’s presidential registration uses MRN. We do not declare them the same legal entity or treasury. That relationship requires organizational and financial records.

text.ht: Pou yon moun ki kontribye, kesyon pratik yo se kiyès ki resevwa lajan, ki resi li bay ak ki sèvis oswa aktivite montan an finanse. Lè yon paj melanje sèvis ak yon mouvman politik, separe kont yo ta pèmèt moun konprann angajman yo.
text.en: For a contributor, the practical questions concern who receives money, the receipt issued and the services or activities funded. When a page combines services with a political movement, separate accounts would help people understand their commitments.

text.ht: Sa pa yon jijman sou kwayans manm yo, ni yon akizasyon lajan achte desizyon piblik. Se yon demann nòmal pou transparans sou yon aktivite ki sèvi ak non yon kandida.
text.en: This is neither a judgment on members’ beliefs nor an allegation that payments buy public decisions. It is ordinary scrutiny of an activity using a candidate’s name.

title.ht: Jude Elie nan NYCHA: sa yon organigram ofisyèl konfime
title.en: Jude Elie at NYCHA: what an official chart confirms

description.ht: Yon dokiman 2018 bay yon pwen presi pou egzamine eksperyans li nan lojman.
description.en: A 2018 document provides a specific basis for examining his housing experience.

text.ht: Sou sit biyografi li a, Jude Elie mete eksperyans NYCHA, ajans lojman piblik Nouyòk la, nan pakou li. Gen yon dokiman apa sou sit Vil Nouyòk ki bay yon pwen pou verifye sa: yon organigram 2018 nan depatman planifikasyon pwojè NYCHA.
text.en: Jude Elie includes experience at NYCHA, New York’s public housing authority, in his online biography. A separate document on New York City’s website provides a checkable point: a 2018 organization chart for NYCHA capital planning.

text.ht: Sou dyagram nan, non li parèt pami twa « A/E Planners », anba responsab bezwen fizik bilding yo. Nou verifye plas non an vizyèlman. Dokiman an bay yon fonksyon nan yon ekip nan epòk sa a; li pa etabli travay aktyèl li oswa yon evalyasyon pèfòmans li.
text.en: The diagram places his name among three “A/E Planners,” under the Physical Needs Manager. We examined that placement visually. The document identifies a team role at that time; it does not establish present employment or assess his performance.

text.ht: Sa pi itil pase repete yon gwo non enstitisyon san esplike fonksyon an. Planifye travay sou lojman mande pou idantifye bezwen, fikse priyorite epi mete pwojè nan yon kalandriye ak yon bidjè. Pou mezire eksperyans kandida a, fòk nou konnen ki travay li te responsab egzakteman.
text.en: This is more useful than repeating a major institution’s name without explaining the role. Housing-work planning involves identifying needs, setting priorities and fitting projects to schedules and budgets. Assessing the candidate’s experience requires his specific responsibilities.

text.ht: Dosye ki ta fè evalyasyon an pi solid se pwojè li te travay sou yo, wòl li nan desizyon yo ak rezilta ki dokimante. Yon moun ka gen yon wòl itil san li dirije tout ajans lan; travay nan yon gwo ajans pa fè tout rezilta ajans lan tounen rezilta pèsonèl li.
text.en: Project records, decision responsibilities and documented outcomes would strengthen assessment. Someone can make a useful contribution without heading an agency; employment does not make every agency outcome a personal achievement.

text.ht: Pou Ayiti, kesyon an se sa eksperyans sa a ka pote nan fason yo planifye ak antreteni lojman. Organigram nan ede kòmanse egzamen an ak yon fonksyon ak yon ane, olye yon tit ki rete flou.
text.en: For Haiti, the question is what that experience can bring to housing planning and maintenance. The chart starts the examination with a role and year, rather than an undefined title.

title.ht: Jude Elie: enterè antrepriz yo bezwen yon kat ki klè
title.en: Jude Elie: business interests need a clear map

description.ht: De paj piblik bay pwen depa sou aktivite prive li; yo pa yon deklarasyon konplè byen.
description.en: Two public pages identify starting points for examining private interests, not a complete asset declaration.

text.ht: Sou paj ekip Million Billion Group la, Jude Elie prezante kòm patnè pou estrateji enfrastrikti ak devlopman. Paj la toujou te nonmen l lè nou telechaje l 15 Novanm 2026. Se yon deklarasyon sou sit konpayi an, pa yon lis aksyonè nou verifye.
text.en: Million Billion Group’s team page presents Jude Elie as a partner for infrastructure and development strategy. It still named him when downloaded November 15, 2026. This is a company-site statement, not a verified shareholder register.

text.ht: Sou pwòp biyografi li, li deklare li posede EJDECO nan konstriksyon, GESA Green Energy ak SEPSA nan distribisyon petwòl. Paj la pa bay yon dat piblikasyon ki pèmèt nou sipoze tout enfòmasyon sa yo se yon deklarasyon byen aktyalize.
text.en: His own biography says he owns construction company EJDECO, GESA Green Energy and petroleum-distribution company SEPSA. The page supplies no publication date allowing us to treat these statements as an updated asset declaration.

text.ht: Pwen enterè piblik la se sektè yo. Enfrastrikti, enèji ak gaz se domèn kote leta ka bay kontra, fikse règ oswa pran desizyon sou taks. Sa pa pwouve kandida a resevwa favè; sa montre ki enterè ekonomik yon evalyasyon dwe idantifye.
text.en: The public-interest point is the sectors. Infrastructure, energy and fuel involve public contracts, regulation or tax decisions. That does not establish that the candidate received favours; it identifies financial interests an assessment needs to map.

text.ht: Yon kat serye ta separe sa li posede, sa li sèlman konseye ak sa li deja kite. Li ta bay dat, pati li genyen ak responsablite li. Mo « patnè » a poukont li pa di konbyen aksyon, lajan oswa pouvwa yon moun genyen.
text.en: A sound map would separate ownership, advisory work and ended relationships, with dates, interests held and responsibilities. The word “partner” alone cannot tell us a person’s equity, money or decision-making power.

text.ht: Ni non konpayi yo ni moun ki parèt sou menm sit la pa prèv yo finanse kanpay la. Pou fè lyen sa a, fòk gen tras kontribisyon oswa peman. Se sou tras sa yo egzamen finansman an dwe chita.
text.en: Neither company names nor appearing on the same website establishes campaign financing. That link requires contribution or payment records. Those records should anchor financial scrutiny.

title.ht: Martelly ak Bodeau: poukisa sanksyon aletranje pa bay yon repons otomatik sou eleksyon an
title.en: Martelly and Bodeau: why foreign sanctions do not automatically settle election eligibility

description.ht: Pou konprann prezans yo nan tablo enskripsyon an, fòk nou separe twa desizyon diferan.
description.en: Understanding their presence on the registration dashboard requires separating three different decisions.

text.ht: Michel Martelly ak Gary Bodeau anba sanksyon ameriken. Poutan, toude non yo parèt nan tablo enskripsyon prezidansyèl KEP la. Kontradiksyon an sèlman parèt senp si nou trete tout lis sanksyon tankou yon sèl lis.
text.en: Michel Martelly and Gary Bodeau face U.S. sanctions. Yet both names appear on the CEP’s presidential registration dashboard. The apparent contradiction looks simple only if every sanctions list is treated as the same list.

text.ht: Nan dekrè 6 Oktòb 2026 la, pwen 8 atik 76 la site sanksyon Konsèy Sekirite Nasyonzini. Se pa menm otorite ak Trezò ameriken. Nan fichye ofisyèl ONU ki pwodui 15 Novanm lan, nou pa jwenn ni Martelly ni Bodeau.
text.en: In the October 6, 2026 decree, Article 76’s eighth condition names UN Security Council sanctions. That is a different authority from the U.S. Treasury. Neither Martelly nor Bodeau appears in the official UN file generated November 15.

text.ht: Sa pa vle di sanksyon ameriken yo disparèt. Yon règ elektoral ayisyen pa efase yon mezi yon lòt peyi. Li pa bay nonplis yon sètifika inosans sou sa otorite etranje yo te deklare.
text.en: This does not make U.S. sanctions disappear. A Haitian electoral rule does not erase another country’s measures. Nor does it certify innocence regarding the foreign authorities’ stated grounds.

text.ht: Epi atik 76 la gen lòt kondisyon; li fè referans tou ak kondisyon Konstitisyon an. Prezans yon non sou yon tablo enskripsyon pa yon desizyon final sou tout pyès oswa tout kondisyon sa yo. Nou pa anonse KEP oblije aksepte oswa rejte yon moun.
text.en: Article 76 has other conditions and also refers to constitutional requirements. A name on a registration dashboard is not a final determination on every document or requirement. We are not declaring that the CEP must admit or reject either person.

text.ht: Men twa kesyon piblik la dwe kenbe separe: ki rezon ki dèyè sanksyon an; ki règ KEP aplike pou admisyon; epi ki chwa elektè yo fè apre egzamen dosye a. Reponn youn pa otomatikman reponn de lòt yo.
text.en: The public therefore faces three separate questions: the grounds for sanctions, the rule the CEP applies to admission, and voters’ judgment after examining the record. Answering one does not automatically answer the others.

title.ht: Célestin ak Martelly an 2010: 234 pwosè-vèbal ak yon dezyèm tou ki chanje
title.en: Célestin and Martelly in 2010: 234 tally sheets and a changed runoff

description.ht: Rapò OEA a ak kritik sou metòd li montre poukisa yon rekalkil pa menm bagay ak yon rekontaj konplè.
description.en: The OAS report and criticism of its method show why recalculation differs from a full recount.

text.ht: Lè rezilta preliminè 7 Desanm 2010 yo soti, Jude Célestin te dezyèm, Michel Martelly te twazyèm. Apre verifikasyon ak kontestasyon, Martelly te antre nan dezyèm tou a, Célestin te soti. Rapò OEA/KARIKÒM lan rakonte kijan sa te pase.
text.en: When preliminary results appeared on December 7, 2010, Jude Célestin ranked second and Michel Martelly third. Following verification and challenges, Martelly entered the runoff and Célestin was excluded. The OAS/CARICOM report describes the process.

text.ht: Misyon an te rekòmande retire 234 pwosè-vèbal li te jije pa respekte règ yo. Yon pwosè-vèbal rasanble rezilta yon biwo vòt; retire li ka retire anpil vòt an menm tan. Se konsa yon koreksyon sou dokiman ka chanje lòd kandida yo san yo pa rekonte chak bilten.
text.en: The mission recommended excluding 234 tally sheets it considered irregular. A tally sheet records a polling station’s results; excluding it can remove many votes together. Document-level corrections can therefore change the order of candidates without recounting every ballot.

text.ht: Men kesyon an pa t sèlman si kèk fèy te gen pwoblèm. Nan analiz Janvye 2011 yo sou pwojè rapò a, Mark Weisbrot ak Jake Johnston nan CEPR te mande poukisa menm tès yo pa t aplike sou tout fèy yo. Yo te kritike tou fason yo te trete pwosè-vèbal ki manke oswa ki te mete apa yo.
text.en: The issue was not merely whether some sheets had problems. In their January 2011 analysis of the draft report, CEPR’s Mark Weisbrot and Jake Johnston questioned why the same tests were not applied to every sheet. They also challenged the treatment of missing or quarantined returns.

text.ht: Kritik sa a pa poukont li pwouve Célestin te genyen yon eleksyon ki ta dwe bay li pouvwa. Rapò misyon an pa poukont li yon prèv chak vòt peyi a te verifye. Se de limit diferan, epi yo dwe rete vizib ansanm.
text.en: That criticism does not itself prove Célestin won an election that entitled him to office. The mission’s report does not itself establish that every vote nationwide was checked. These are separate limits that should remain visible together.

text.ht: Pou yon elektè, leson an konkrè: anvan ou aksepte fraz « yo korije rezilta a », mande ki dokiman yo retire, ak ki règ, epi si tout kandida sibi menm tès la. Yon metòd dwe ka esplike tou de sa li korije ak sa li kite san repons.
text.en: For voters, the practical lesson is to ask what documents were excluded, under which rules, and whether every candidate faced the same test. A method must explain both what it corrected and what it left unresolved.

title.ht: Hans Joseph: yon milyon dola sou papye, men kay yo pa t kòmanse
title.en: Hans Joseph: a million dollars on paper, but the houses had not started

description.ht: Yon dokiman ULCC nan achiv OEA a montre sa yon imaj kapab revele, ak sa li pa kapab tranche.
description.en: An ULCC document in the OAS archive shows what an image can reveal and what it cannot decide.

text.ht: Sou papye, yon pwojè kay sosyal te resevwa yon milyon dola ameriken. Nan imaj yon dròn te pran sou teren an, konstriksyon kay yo pa t kòmanse. Se konsa ULCC te rakonte yon ankèt nan yon dokiman li te soumèt nan mekanis antikòripsyon OEA a an 2021.
text.en: On paper, a social-housing project had received one million U.S. dollars. In drone images of the site, house construction had not begun. That is how the ULCC described an investigation in its 2021 submission to the OAS anti-corruption mechanism.

text.ht: Dokiman an site Hans Jacques Ludwig Joseph kòm direktè jeneral. Li di dimansyon teren an pa t koresponn ak sa pwojè a te prezante. Sa se yon eleman nan dosye enstitisyon li t ap dirije a, pa yon istwa ki montre li menm te pilote dròn nan.
text.en: The document names Hans Jacques Ludwig Joseph as director general. It says the land’s dimensions did not match the project’s description. This belongs to the record of the institution he led; it does not establish that he personally operated the drone.

text.ht: Sa ki enteresan se metòd la: konpare sa yon administrasyon peye ak sa ki egziste toutbon. Yon kontra ak yon resi pa sifi pou montre yon fanmi gen yon kay. Foto, vizit sou teren, dimansyon ak tras peman dwe kapab reponn youn lòt.
text.en: The useful method is comparing what an administration pays for with what actually exists. A contract and receipt do not establish that a family has a home. Images, site visits, measurements and payment records should be checked against each other.

text.ht: Men dokiman an se prezantasyon ULCC sou pwòp travay li. Li pa bay isit la yon jijman final oswa yon kont konplè sou lajan yo ta rekipere. Nou pa fè yon akizasyon ankèt tounen yon kondanasyon.
text.en: But this is the ULCC’s account of its own work. It does not provide a final judgment here or a complete accounting of money recovered. We do not turn an investigative allegation into a conviction.

text.ht: Kòm kandida, Joseph ka esplike kijan li ta fè kontwòl sa a tounen yon abitid Leta: verifye livrezon anvan dènye peman, konsève prèv yo, epi suiv dosye a jouk tribinal ak rekiperasyon lajan lè sa jistifye. Jwenn yon twou nan yon dosye se kòmansman travay la, pa tout rezilta a.
text.en: As a candidate, Joseph can explain how he would make this routine: verify delivery before final payment, preserve evidence, and follow justified cases through court and recovery. Finding a discrepancy starts the work; it does not complete the outcome.

title.ht: Hans Joseph: denonse kòripsyon pa dwe mande yon vwayaj Pòtoprens
title.en: Hans Joseph: reporting corruption should not require a trip to Port-au-Prince

description.ht: De dokiman Leta mete aksè sitwayen an nan mitan bilan antikòripsyon an.
description.en: Two State documents put citizens’ access at the center of the anti-corruption record.

text.ht: Imajine yon sitwayen ki gen prèv yo mande li lajan anba tab, men ki pa ka peye transpò oswa jwenn entènèt. Yon pòtal denonsyasyon ka egziste san moun sa a pa kapab sèvi avè l. Se yon egzanp pou konprann pwoblèm nan, pa temwayaj yon moun nou entèvyouve.
text.en: Imagine a citizen with evidence of a bribe demand who cannot afford travel or internet. A complaint portal can exist without being usable by that person. This is an illustration of the problem, not testimony from someone we interviewed.

text.ht: An 2021, ULCC, ki te anba direksyon Hans Jacques Ludwig Joseph, te rekonèt pri entènèt ak mank aksè nan zòn rekile kòm baryè nan yon dokiman li te soumèt bay OEA. Sa te limite valè zouti dijital li yo pou enfòme piblik la ak ankouraje denonsyasyon.
text.en: In 2021, the ULCC under Hans Jacques Ludwig Joseph acknowledged internet costs and poor access in remote areas as barriers in its OAS submission. Those conditions limited the value of digital tools for informing the public and encouraging reports.

text.ht: Nan rapò pwogrè pou peryòd Mas 2024–Fevriye 2025 la, Leta rapòte ouvèti yon biwo ULCC nan Nòdès, 24 Janvye 2025. Objektif li deklare a se te pwoche sèvis la ak popilasyon an, pou denonsyasyon ak deklarasyon patrimwàn.
text.en: In its March 2024–February 2025 progress report, the State records a Nord-Est ULCC office opening on January 24, 2025. Its stated purpose was to bring complaint and asset-declaration services closer to residents.

text.ht: Ouvèti a se yon aksyon konkrè nan bilan enstitisyon an. Men li pa di poukont li konbyen moun ki jwenn sèvis, konbyen plent yo trete oswa konbyen tan sa pran. Nou pa bay yon seremoni valè yon evalyasyon rezilta.
text.en: The opening is a concrete institutional action. It does not itself establish how many people received service, how many complaints were handled or how long they waited. A ceremony is not an outcome evaluation.

text.ht: Pou egzamine pwopozisyon prezidansyèl Joseph yo, yon bon kesyon se ki sèvis yon moun san gwo mwayen ap ka jwenn depi premye kontak la rive nan swivi dosye a. Yon sistèm serye dwe pwoteje prèv ak moun ki pote yo, epi bay repons ki ka suiv. Aksè se yon pati nan jistis la.
text.en: A useful test of Joseph’s presidential proposals is what service a person with little money can obtain from first contact through follow-up. A serious system should protect evidence and the people providing it, with responses that can be tracked. Access is part of justice.

title.ht: Wilner Joseph ak primè VIKTWA a: de rapò, de kantite vòt
title.en: Wilner Joseph and the VIKTWA primary: two reports, two vote counts

description.ht: Tou de rapò yo bay li viktwa; yo pa bay menm chif. Pwosè-vèbal la enpòtan.
description.en: Both reports name him the winner, but their figures differ. The minutes matter.

text.ht: Wilner Joseph te genyen seleksyon entèn VIKTWA pou prezidans lan an Septanm 2026. Men mete de rapò sou vòt la kòtakòt, epi chif yo pa menm. Se yon diferans ki merite klarifikasyon, san nou pa envante yon fwod.
text.en: Wilner Joseph won VIKTWA’s internal presidential selection in September 2026. But place two reports of the vote side by side and their numbers differ. The discrepancy merits clarification without inventing fraud.

text.ht: Juno7, 10 Septanm, rapòte 43 patisipan sou 52 pati regroupman an di li genyen: 39 vòt pou Joseph, 3 pou Jean Nerva Siméon, ak yon vòt blan. Atik la atribye chif sa yo ak kominike VIKTWA.
text.en: Juno7 on September 10 reports 43 participants from the grouping’s claimed 52 parties: 39 votes for Joseph, three for Jean Nerva Siméon, and one blank. It attributes those figures to VIKTWA’s communiqué.

text.ht: FCN, nan atik 11 Septanm li a, bay Joseph 43 vòt sou 49, epi li bay rival la 3. Se pa menm total oswa menm kantite vòt pou gayan an. Nou poko jwenn pwosè-vèbal orijinal la ki ta pèmèt nou tranche diferans lan.
text.en: FCN’s September 11 article gives Joseph 43 votes out of 49, with three for his rival. Neither the total nor the winner’s tally matches. We have not located the original minutes needed to resolve the discrepancy.

text.ht: Tou de vèsyon yo dekri yon viktwa laj pou Joseph. Diferans lan pa prèv li te pèdi, ni prèv pati yo te fè magouy. Li montre poukisa yon rezilta entèn dwe gen yon tras ki pi solid pase repete menm nouvèl sou plizyè sit.
text.en: Both versions describe a substantial Joseph victory. The difference is not proof he lost or that parties manipulated the vote. It shows why an internal result needs a record stronger than repeated news coverage.

text.ht: Piblikasyon règ seleksyon yo, kantite estrikti ki te kalifye, total patisipan ak rezilta siyen an ta fè pwosesis la pi fasil egzamine. Epi sipò yon gwoup lidè pa mezire sipò tout elektè peyi a: yon primè pati pa yon sondaj nasyonal.
text.en: Publishing selection rules, eligible structures, participation totals and signed results would make the process easier to examine. Support among party leaders does not measure support among the country’s voters: an internal primary is not a national poll.

title.ht: Salomon an 2020: Sena a te pèmanan, men kiyès ki te chwazi prezidan li?
title.en: Salomon in 2020: a permanent Senate, but who chose its president?

description.ht: Yon ansyen kriz montre diferans ant defann yon enstitisyon ak resevwa otorite pou dirije li.
description.en: An old crisis shows the difference between defending an institution and receiving authority to lead it.

text.ht: 13 Janvye 2020, pandan diskisyon sou fen manda palmantè yo, Jean-Marie Junior Salomon te anonse li pran fonksyon prezidan Sena a pwovizwaman. Rezo Nòdwès rapòte li te site atik 95-1 Konstitisyon an sou karaktè pèmanan Sena a.
text.en: On January 13, 2020, amid the dispute over parliamentary terms, Jean-Marie Junior Salomon announced that he was provisionally assuming the Senate presidency. Rezo Nòdwès reports that he invoked Constitution Article 95-1 on the Senate’s permanent character.

text.ht: Men menm atik laprès la bay yon lòt repè. Sekretè jeneral Sena a, Rony Gilot, te raple règ entèn ki prevwa yon eleksyon ak bilten sekrè pou nouvo biwo a, epi yon wòl pwovizwa pou dwayen laj la pandan yo tann eleksyon an.
text.en: The same article supplies another reference point. Senate secretary-general Rony Gilot recalled internal rules providing a secret-ballot election for the new bureau and an interim role for the oldest member pending that election.

text.ht: De agiman sa yo pa reponn menm kesyon an. Youn pale sou egzistans enstitisyon an; lòt la sou fason li bay yon moun otorite pou dirije li. Menm lè yon kriz pa dwe fè yon enstitisyon disparèt, sa pa otomatikman esplike kiyès ki gen dwa pale nan non li.
text.en: Those arguments address different questions. One concerns the institution’s continued existence; the other concerns how it grants someone authority to lead. Even if a crisis should not extinguish an institution, that does not automatically identify who can speak for it.

text.ht: Nou pa sèvi ak atik laprès sa a pou rann yon jijman sou tout manda ki te an diskisyon yo. Li etabli pozisyon moun yo te eksprime nan moman an; li pa ranplase desizyon oswa pwosè-vèbal ki ta montre kijan kriz la te regle.
text.en: We do not use this news report to adjudicate every disputed term. It records positions expressed at the time; it does not replace the decisions or minutes that would show how the crisis was resolved.

text.ht: Pou yon kandida prezidan ki mete respè enstitisyon devan, dosye sa a poze yon kesyon sou pratik pouvwa: lè tèks yo ak aktè yo pa dakò, ki pwosedi li aksepte pou deside? Repons lan enpòtan sitou lè pwosedi a ka pa ba li sa li vle.
text.en: For a presidential candidate emphasizing institutions, this raises a practical question about power: when texts and political actors conflict, what decision process does he accept? The answer matters especially when that process might deny him what he wants.

title.ht: Renois ak Maxo Joseph: sa chwa kandida pwotestan 2015 la te vle di
title.en: Renois and Maxo Joseph: what the 2015 Protestant candidate selection meant

description.ht: Yon antant ant lidè te chwazi yon kandida; li pa t transfere vòt sitwayen yo.
description.en: An agreement among leaders selected a candidate; it did not transfer citizens’ votes.

text.ht: An Septanm 2015, yon komite fasilitasyon pastè Gérald Bataille t ap dirije te chwazi Jean Clarens Renois kòm kandida pou reprezante sektè pwotestan an, dapre Rezo Nòdwès. Maxo Joseph te youn nan sèt kandida ki te antre nan antant pou chwazi yon sèl moun.
text.en: In September 2015, a facilitation committee led by pastor Gérald Bataille selected Jean Clarens Renois to represent the Protestant sector, according to Rezo Nòdwès. Maxo Joseph was among seven candidates participating in the agreement to select one person.

text.ht: Rapò a dekri de etap negosyasyon. Premye a te kenbe twa non: Renois, Jean-Chavannes Jeune ak Jean Palème Mathurin. Apre diskisyon, chwa a te tonbe sou Renois. Sa rakonte kijan lidè yo te chèche rasanble plizyè kandidati dèyè yon sèl moun.
text.en: The report describes two negotiating stages. The first retained three names: Renois, Jean-Chavannes Jeune and Jean Palème Mathurin. Discussions then produced the Renois choice. This records how leaders sought to consolidate several candidacies behind one.

text.ht: Li pa etabli tout legliz oswa tout elektè pwotestan te patisipe nan desizyon an. Li pa bay nonplis prèv tout lòt kandida yo te retire non yo nan bilten an. Siyen yon antant, bay sipò ak kite yon kous elektoral se aksyon diferan.
text.en: It does not establish that every church or Protestant voter participated. Nor does it prove all the other candidates removed their names from the ballot. Signing an agreement, endorsing someone and withdrawing from an election are different actions.

text.ht: Pou konprann baz politik yon kandida, fòk nou gade rezo ki ede li jwenn soutyen: pati, asosyasyon, legliz oswa lòt gwoup. Men okenn rezo pa posede vòt moun ki ladan l yo. Yon moun kapab pataje yon lafwa epi fè yon lòt chwa politik.
text.en: Understanding a candidate’s political base requires examining networks that help mobilize support: parties, associations, churches and other groups. No network owns its members’ votes. People can share a faith and make different political choices.

text.ht: Istwa sa a ede li prezans Renois ak Maxo Joseph nan kous aktyèl la san envante yon alyans ki ta kontinye otomatikman depi 2015. Pou konnen kiyès ki apiye kiyès jodi a, fòk gen yon deklarasyon oswa yon angajman aktyèl. Yon ansyen antant se yon pati nan pakou yo, pa yon chèk politik san dat ekspirasyon.
text.en: This history helps explain Renois’s and Maxo Joseph’s political paths without inventing an alliance automatically continuing from 2015. Present support requires a current statement or commitment. An old agreement belongs in their record; it is not a political blank check without an expiry date.

title.ht: Kely Bastien an 2010: ki limit yon pouvwa san manda popilè dwe genyen?
title.en: Kely Bastien in 2010: what limits should unelected power face?

description.ht: Apre tranblemanntè a, li te pale sou delè ak lejitimite. Pozisyon an merite rete nan memwa politik la.
description.en: After the earthquake, he discussed deadlines and legitimacy. That position belongs in the political record.

text.ht: An Mas 2010, Ayiti t ap chèche kijan pou li renouvle enstitisyon li apre tranblemanntè a. Fen manda René Préval la t ap pwoche. Kelly Bastien, prezidan Sena a nan moman an, te mande aktè yo egzamine opsyon ki pi pre Konstitisyon an, selon Radio Métropole.
text.en: In March 2010, Haiti was considering how to renew its institutions after the earthquake, with René Préval’s term approaching its end. Senate president Kelly Bastien urged political actors to examine the option closest to the Constitution, according to Radio Métropole.

text.ht: Li pa t elimine posiblite yon gouvènman pwovizwa. Men li te mete aksan sou efò pou òganize yon eleksyon nan 90 jou, epi li te kritike lide bay yon gouvènman san lejitimite popilè yon manda yon ane. Se yon pozisyon laprès rapòte, pa yon delè nou prezante kòm lwa li te fè aplike.
text.en: He did not rule out a provisional government. But he emphasized efforts to hold an election within 90 days and criticized giving an administration without popular legitimacy a one-year mandate. This is a reported position, not a deadline we claim he enacted.

text.ht: Difikilte a fasil pou konprann: kriz la ka anpeche yon eleksyon fèt alè, men moun ki pran pouvwa pou jere kriz la pa resevwa yon otorizasyon san limit pou rete. Delè yo dwe mache ak sa ki dwe fèt, kiyès ki responsab epi kijan piblik la ka verifye pwogrè.
text.en: The dilemma is straightforward: a crisis may prevent an election on time, but those managing it do not receive unlimited permission to remain. Deadlines should identify what must happen, who is responsible and how the public can check progress.

text.ht: Yon ansyen deklarasyon pa pwouve li te rezoud kriz la, ni li pa reponn otomatikman tout sitiyasyon ki vini apre. Men li montre yon prensip Bastien te mete devan pandan li te okipe yon gwo fonksyon Leta.
text.en: An old statement does not prove he resolved that crisis or automatically answer every later situation. It does establish a principle Bastien advanced while holding high public office.

text.ht: Kòm kandida jodi a, li ka esplike ki garanti li ta aksepte pou anpeche eksepsyon vin pèmanan: rapò piblik sou reta, kontwòl endepandan ak konsekans pou angajman ki pa respekte. Mande limit pou lòt moun genyen tout sans li lè ou pare pou menm limit yo mare pwòp pouvwa ou.
text.en: As a candidate today, he can explain what safeguards he would accept to keep exceptions temporary: public accounts of delays, independent oversight and consequences for missed commitments. Demanding limits on others matters most when one accepts those limits on one’s own power.

title.ht: Muscadin: kiyès ki posede machin blende donatè yo te achte a?
title.en: Muscadin: who owns the armored vehicle donors bought?

description.ht: Apre yon koleksyon piblik ak demisyon li, yon kesyon sou byen ak responsablite rete.
description.en: After public fundraising and his resignation, an ownership and accountability question remains.

text.ht: An Mas 2023, jounalis Theriel Thelus te lanse yon koleksyon pou achte de machin blende pou Jean Ernest Muscadin. Twa mwa apre, Juno7 te rapòte livrezon yon Nissan Patrol blende. Thelus te deklare machin nan te koute 45 000 dola, epi blendaj la 55 000 dola: 100 000 dola ameriken ansanm.
text.en: In March 2023, journalist Theriel Thelus launched fundraising for two armored vehicles for Jean Ernest Muscadin. Three months later, Juno7 reported delivery of one armored Nissan Patrol. Thelus stated that the vehicle cost $45,000 and armor $55,000: $100,000 together.

text.ht: Fòk objektif koleksyon an rete separe ak livrezon yo rapòte a. De machin ki te anonse pa prèv de machin te livre. Depans Thelus bay la pa yon fakti nou verifye, epi atik la pa yon kont odit sou tout lajan ki te antre ak sa ki te soti.
text.en: The fundraising target must remain separate from the reported delivery. Announcing two vehicles does not establish two were delivered. Thelus’s stated cost is not an invoice we verified, and the article is not an audited account of all receipts and expenditure.

text.ht: Kesyon an vin pi konkrè apre demisyon Muscadin nan. Dapre atik Juno7 sou lèt ministè a, minis Patrick Pélissier te aksepte depa li an Novanm 2026. Yon machin ki sèvi yon fonksyon piblik dwe gen yon estati klè lè moun ki te resevwa li a kite fonksyon an.
text.en: The question becomes more concrete following Muscadin’s resignation. Juno7’s account of the ministry’s letter says minister Patrick Pélissier accepted his departure in November 2026. A vehicle serving a public function needs clear status when its recipient leaves office.

text.ht: Èske tit la nan non Leta, yon òganizasyon oswa yon moun? Kiyès ki peye antretyen, asirans ak gaz? Èske gen yon envantè oswa yon dokiman ki fikse itilizasyon li apre depa a? Se kesyon nòmal sou yon byen ki te finanse ak yon apèl piblik.
text.en: Is the title held by the State, an organization or an individual? Who pays maintenance, insurance and fuel? Does an inventory or agreement govern use after departure? These are ordinary questions about an asset financed through a public appeal.

text.ht: Nou pa prezante don an kòm prèv kòripsyon, ni kòm finansman otomatik kanpay 2026 la. Li montre kijan sipò sitwayen pou sekirite ka kreye yon lòt obligasyon: konnen sa yo finanse, kiyès ki responsab li ak sa li vin tounen.
text.en: We do not present the donation as proof of corruption or automatic financing of the 2026 campaign. It shows how citizens’ support for security can create another obligation: knowing what they funded, who is accountable for it and what becomes of it.

title.ht: Muscadin ak lèt blam 2023 la: sekirite ak limit pouvwa
title.en: Muscadin and the 2023 reprimand: security and limits on power

description.ht: Yon ansyen lèt ministè a poze yon kesyon ki depase popilarite yon komisè.
description.en: An earlier ministry letter raises a question that goes beyond a prosecutor’s popularity.

text.ht: An Desanm 2023, ministè Jistis la te raple Jean Ernest Muscadin obligasyon rann kont li ak limit jiridiksyon li. Nan lèt Juno7 te rapòte a, ministè a te kritike entèvansyon li nan yon lòt jiridiksyon san otorizasyon epi yon blokaj wout patizan te fè nan non li.
text.en: In December 2023, the justice ministry reminded Jean Ernest Muscadin of accountability obligations and jurisdictional limits. In the letter reported by Juno7, the ministry criticized intervention in another jurisdiction without authorization and a roadblock supporters had mounted in his name.

text.ht: Se pozisyon ministè a nan yon lèt blam; se pa yon kondanasyon tribinal nou prezante. Men dokiman sa a enpòtan paske li montre otorite siperyè li te poze kesyon sou fason li te egzèse pouvwa, pa sèlman sou rezilta li t ap reklame yo.
text.en: This is the ministry’s position in a reprimand, not a criminal conviction we present. The document matters because it shows his supervising authority questioning how he exercised power, beyond the outcomes he claimed.

text.ht: Atik la pale tou sou yon lòt lèt pou Ronald Richemond. Kritik sou entèwogasyon yon pwopriyetè otèl nan dosye sa a konsène Richemond. Li pa dwe transfere sou Muscadin poutèt de non yo parèt nan menm atik la.
text.en: The article also discusses a separate letter to Ronald Richemond. Criticism of a hotel owner’s questioning concerns Richemond. It must not be transferred to Muscadin because both names appear in one article.

text.ht: Pou piblik la, kesyon ki rete a se kiyès ki ka mete yon fren lè yon ajan Leta deklare aksyon li nesesè pou sekirite. Si otorizasyon, kontwòl ak eksplikasyon sèlman aplike lè yon ajan pa popilè, se popilarite ki vin ranplase règ yo.
text.en: For the public, the issue is who can impose limits when a State agent says action is necessary for security. If authorization, oversight and explanation apply only to unpopular officials, popularity replaces the rules.

text.ht: Nan egzamen kandidati Muscadin nan, sa mande yon repons sou kontwòl li ta aksepte sou pwòp aksyon li: kiyès ki ka revize yon lòd, ki prèv li konsève ak ki kote yon sitwayen ka pote plent. Pwoteje popilasyon an ak rann kont sou mwayen yo itilize pou sa se menm responsablite piblik la.
text.en: Scrutinizing Muscadin’s candidacy therefore requires an answer about oversight he would accept over his own actions: who can review an order, what evidence is preserved and where a citizen can complain. Protecting residents and accounting for the means used are parts of the same public responsibility.
